If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.
spell->Dispel Magic.target: 1 spell effect or unattended magic item

spell->Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
spell->Detect Magic.description:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

spell->Guidance.name: Guidance
spell->Guidance.description:
You ask for the guidance of supernatural entities, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}

spell->Mending.name: Mending
spell->Mending.description:
You repair the target item. You restore 5 Hit Points per spell rank to the target, potentially removing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} condition if this repairs it past the item's Broken Threshold. You can't replace lost pieces or repair an object that's been completely destroyed.

Heightened (2nd) You can target a non-magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Heightened (3rd) You can target a non-magical object of 2 Bulk or less, or a magical object of 1 Bulk or less.
spell->Mending.target: non-magical object of light Bulk or less

spell->Mindlink.name: Mindlink
spell->Mindlink.description: You link your mind to the target's mind and mentally impart to that target an amount of information in an instant that could otherwise be communicated in 10 minutes.

spell->Sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
spell->Sanctuary.description:
You ward a creature with protective energy that deters attacks. Creatures attempting to attack the target must attempt a Will save each time. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends.

Critical Success Sanctuary ends.

Success The creature can attempt its attack and any other attacks against the target this turn.

Failure The creature can't attack the target and wastes the action. It can't attempt further attacks against the target this turn.

Critical Failure The creature wastes the action and can't attempt to attack the target for the rest of sanctuary's duration.

spell->Share Lore.name: Share Lore
spell->Share Lore.description:
You share your knowledge with the touched creatures. Choose one Lore skill in which you're trained. The targets become trained in that Lore skill for the duration of the spell.

Heightened (3rd) The duration of the spell is 1 hour, and you can target up to five creatures.

Heightened (5th) The duration of the spell is 8 hours, you can target up to five creatures, and you can share up to two Lore skills in which you're trained.

spell->Telekinetic Projectile.name: Telekinetic Projectile
spell->Telekinetic Projectile.description:
You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

action->Even the Scales.name: Even the Scales
action->Even the Scales.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect All willing allies within 30 feet immediately take the necessary amount of healing or damage to bring them to exactly half the maximum Hit Points of the participant with the lowest maximum Hit Points, losing the dying condition and regaining consciousness if applicable. At least one creature must be healed and at least one damaged for the ability to function.

action->Gestalt.name: Gestalt
action->Gestalt.description: Balance grants the following additional spells to any gestalt they join: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pkcOby5prOausy1k]{Read Omens}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.3E1p58MNQMO4GAxt]{Stagnate Time}.

action->+2 Status to All Saves vs. Disea.name: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Disease and Poison

action->Not Done With You!.name: Not Done With You!
action->Not Done With You!.description:
Trigger A creature within Baulrica's reach leaves a square during a move action it's using

Effect Baulrica attempts to [[/act grapple]] the creature. On a success, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

action->Beat Down.name: Beat Down
action->Beat Down.description: Baulrica makes two fist Strikes against a single target. Both Strikes count toward Baulrica's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks. If she hits with both Strikes, the target must also succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:30|options:inflicts:prone] save or be knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

action->Eye Gouge.name: Eye Gouge
action->Eye Gouge.description: If Baulrica's last action was a successful fist Strike against a creature, Baulrica jabs her fingers into that creature's eyes. The creature attempts a @Check[fortitude|dc:30|options:inflicts:blinded,inflicts:persistent-damage] save. On a failed save, the creature takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage. On a critical failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for as long as the persistent damage lasts.

Bloating Fleshwarp.name: Bloating Fleshwarp
Bloating Fleshwarp.description: A surge of fleshwarping magic causes creatures to swell with blood.
Bloating Fleshwarp.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:30] (trained) or Occultism (expert) to disrupt the magic, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (6th rank, DC 28) to counteract the fleshwarping

action->Swell.name: Swell
action->Swell.description:
Trigger A creature in the room eats or drinks anything

Effect Each creature in the room must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:32|options:area-effect] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to the effects of warpline hazards for 1 hour.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature's flesh swells with blood. For 1 day, whenever the creature takes piercing or slashing damage, it also takes persistent bleed equal to the number of damage dice.

Critical Failure As failure, except the bleed is equal to twice the number of damage dice, and the effect lasts for 1 week.

Boneburst Fleshwarp.name: Boneburst Fleshwarp
Boneburst Fleshwarp.description: A surge of fleshwarping magic causes bone spurs to rip through flesh.
Boneburst Fleshwarp.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:30] (trained) or Occultism (expert) to disrupt the magic, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (6th rank, DC 28) to counteract the fleshwarping

action->Mangle.name: Mangle
action->Mangle.description:
Trigger A creature passes over or under the bridge, entering the area marked T

Effect Each creature in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:32] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to the effects of warpline hazards for 1 hour.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(3d10+14)[piercing]] damage as bony protrusions pierce their flesh. Until the creature receives magical healing, the DC for skill checks to restore Hit Points to the creature increases by 2, and the creature reduces the number of Hit Points they recover per attempt by 5.

Critical Failure As failure, except the effect lasts 1 week.

action->Web Sense.name: Web Sense
action->Web Sense.description: The spider has imprecise tremorsense to detect the vibrations of creatures touching its web.

action->Bristle Spider Venom.name: Bristle Spider Venom
action->Bristle Spider Venom.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:31|options:damaging-effect,inflicts:clumsy,inflicts:off-guard]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[6d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[6d8[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1}, and off-guard (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[6d8[poison]] damage, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}, and off-guard (1 round)

action->Hair Barrage.name: Hair Barrage
action->Hair Barrage.description: The spider flicks its legs, flinging spiky hairs in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30]. This deals @Damage[6d6[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:33|basic|options:area-effect] save.

action->Web Sense.name: Web Sense
action->Web Sense.description: The spider has imprecise tremorsense to detect the vibrations of creatures touching its web.

action->Cloud of Bristles.name: Cloud of Bristles
action->Cloud of Bristles.description: Each enemy in the spider swarm's space takes @Damage[4d8[piercing]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:32|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:dazzled,inflicts:persistent-damage] save. A creature that fails its save takes @Damage[2d8[persistent,piercing]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for as long as the persistent damage remains.

Carbauxine Gas Deposit.name: Carbauxine Gas Deposit
Carbauxine Gas Deposit.description: A colorless, odorless, and highly flammable gas fills the area.
Carbauxine Gas Deposit.reset: The gas builds up over the course of 24 hours, after which it can trigger again.

action->Combustion.name: Combustion
action->Combustion.description:
Trigger A source of open flame, such as a lit torch or a spell that deals fire damage, is brought into the area

Effect The gas explodes. Any creature in the area takes @Damage[(4d10+22)[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic|options:area-effect] save).

spell->Earthquake.name: Earthquake
spell->Earthquake.description:
You shake the ground, topple creatures into fissures, and collapse structures. The GM might add additional effects in certain areas. Cliffs might collapse, causing creatures to fall, or a lake might drain as fissures open up below its surface, leaving a morass of quicksand.

  • Shaking Ground The ground is difficult terrain, and creatures on it take a -2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls, AC, and skill checks. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.09rtx50laDw68FGT]{Spell Effect: Earthquake (Shaking Ground)}
  • Fissures Each creature on the ground must attempt a Reflex save at the start of its turn to keep its footing and avoid falling into 40-foot-deep fissures that open beneath it. The fissures are permanent, and their sides require successful @Check[athletics|dc:15|traits:action:climb] to Climb.
  • Collapse Structures and ceilings might collapse. The GM rolls a flat check for each (@Check[flat|dc:16] for a sturdy structure, @Check[flat|dc:14] for an average structure and most natural formations, @Check[flat|dc:9] for a shoddy structure, all adjusted higher or lower as the GM sees fit). A collapse deals 11d6 bludgeoning damage to each creature caught in it with a basic Reflex save. A creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} unless it critically succeeds and falls into a fissure if it critically fails.

Heightened (10th) You create a massive earthquake that can devastate a settlement. The range increases to half a mile and the area to a quarter-mile burst.

spell->Heaving Earth.name: Heaving Earth
spell->Heaving Earth.description:
You strike the ground, and unleash a wave that travels through the struck surface to the target. The effect ends as soon as it can't travel through a solid surface, such as a stone floor. Each creature in a line between you and the target is shaken by tremors and must attempt a Reflex saving throw against your spell DC. A creature that fails this save is pushed 10 feet away from you.

The wave explodes once it reaches the target, showering the target with earth and stone and dealing @Damage[12d10[bludgeoning]] damage with a basic Reflex save. A target that fails its save against this explosion is also pushed back 10 feet and knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. A creature subject to the explosion doesn't need to save against the tremors.

Heightened (9th) The wave explodes on one additional target of your choice in the line to the final target.
spell->Heaving Earth.target: 1 creature or object on the ground

spell->Disintegrate.name: Disintegrate
spell->Disintegrate.description:
A black tracer bolt flies toward your target, and upon making contact intensifies into a powerful destructive beam. Make a spell attack against the target. If you hit an object or force construct (such as a wall of force), it's destroyed with no save unless it's an artifact or similarly powerful. A single casting can destroy no more than a 10-foot cube of matter. If you hit a creature, it takes 12d10 damage (no damage type) with a basic Fortitude save. If you critically hit, the target gets a result one degree of success worse than the outcome of its Fortitude save. A creature reduced to 0 HP is blasted to fine powder; its gear remains.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d10.
spell->Disintegrate.target: 1 creature, unattended object, or force construct

spell->Petrify.name: Petrify
spell->Petrify.description:
The target's body slowly turns into a stone statue. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round as stone begins to form on their body.

Failure The target is slowed 1 and must attempt a Fortitude save at the end of each of its turns; this ongoing save has the incapacitation trait. On a failed save, the slowed condition increases by 1 (or 2 on a critical failure) as stone growths creep across their body. A successful save reduces the slowed condition by 1. When a creature becomes fully unable to act due to the slowed condition from petrify, the spell then ends in a flash of gray light, leaving the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified} permanently as they become a statue. The spell also ends if the slowed condition is removed, which causes the stone to break off harmlessly.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is initially @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}.

spell->Petrify.name: Petrify
spell->Petrify.description:
The target's body slowly turns into a stone statue. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round as stone begins to form on their body.

Failure The target is slowed 1 and must attempt a Fortitude save at the end of each of its turns; this ongoing save has the incapacitation trait. On a failed save, the slowed condition increases by 1 (or 2 on a critical failure) as stone growths creep across their body. A successful save reduces the slowed condition by 1. When a creature becomes fully unable to act due to the slowed condition from petrify, the spell then ends in a flash of gray light, leaving the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified} permanently as they become a statue. The spell also ends if the slowed condition is removed, which causes the stone to break off harmlessly.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is initially @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}.

spell->Scrying.name: Scrying
spell->Scrying.description:
You magically spy on a creature of your choice. Scrying works like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance}, except that the image you receive is less precise, insufficient for teleport and similar spells. Instead of creating an eye in a set location within 500 feet, you instead create an eye that manifests just above the target. You can choose a target either by name or by touching one of its possessions or a piece of its body. If you haven't met the target in person, scrying's DC is 2 lower, and if you are unaware of the target's identity (perhaps because you found an unknown creature's fang at a crime scene), the DC is instead 10 lower.

The effect of scrying depends on the target's Will save.

Critical Success The spell fails and the target is temporarily immune for 1 week. The target also gains a glimpse of you and learns its rough distance and direction from you.

Success The spell fails and the target is temporarily immune for 1 day.

Failure The spell succeeds.

Critical Failure The spell succeeds, and the eye follows the target if it moves, traveling up to 60 feet per round.

spell->Teleport.name: Teleport
spell->Teleport.description:
You and the targets are instantly transported to any location within range, as long as you can identify the location precisely both by its position relative to your starting position and by its appearance (or other identifying features). Incorrect knowledge of the location's appearance usually causes the spell to fail, but it could instead lead to teleporting to an unwanted location or some other unusual mishap determined by the GM. Teleport is not precise over great distances. The targets appear at a distance from the intended destination equal to roughly 1 percent of the total distance traveled, in a direction determined by the GM. For short journeys, this lack of precision is irrelevant, but for long distances this could be up to 1 mile.

Heightened (7th) You and the other targets can travel to any location within 1,000 miles.

Heightened (8th) You and the other targets can travel to any location on the same planet. If you travel more than 1,000 miles, you arrive only 10 miles off target.

Heightened (9th) You and the other targets can travel to any location on another planet within the same solar system. Assuming you have accurate knowledge of the location's position and appearance, you arrive on the new planet 100 miles off target.

Heightened (10th) As the 9th-rank version, but you and the other targets can travel to any planet within the same galaxy.
spell->Teleport.target: you and up to 4 targets touched, either willing creatures or objects roughly the size of a creature.

spell->Wall of Force.name: Wall of Force
spell->Wall of Force.description:
You form an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} wall of pure magical force up to 50 feet long and up to 20 feet high. The wall has no discernible thickness. You must create the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost. The wall has AC 10, Hardness 30, and 60 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. The wall blocks physical effects from passing through it, and because it's made of force, it blocks incorporeal and ethereal creatures as well. Teleportation effects can pass through the barrier, as can visual effects (since the wall is invisible). Wall of force is immune to counteracting effects of its level or lower, but the wall is automatically destroyed by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate} spell of any rank.

Heightened (+2) The Hit Points of the wall increase by 20.

spell->Blazing Fissure.name: Blazing Fissure
spell->Blazing Fissure.description:
A thin crack rips through the earth, erupting with magma, then swiftly seals up. Each creature along the line and on solid ground takes 4d6 bludgeoning damage and 6d6 fire damage with a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage, and it falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, and it falls prone.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6 bludgeoning and 1d6 fire.

spell->Speak with Stones (At Will).name: Speak with Stones (At Will)
spell->Speak with Stones (At Will).description:
You can ask questions of and receive answers from natural or worked stone. While stone is not intelligent, you speak with the natural spirits of the stone, which have a personality colored by the type of stone, as well as by the type of structure the stone is part of, for worked stone. A stone's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. Stones can mostly answer questions about creatures that touched them in the past and what is concealed beneath or behind them.

Heightened (6th) The duration is 8 hours.

spell->Wall of Stone.name: Wall of Stone
spell->Wall of Stone.description:
You shape a wall of solid stone. You create a 1-inch-thick wall of stone up to 120 feet long, and 20 feet high. You can shape the wall's path, placing each 5 feet of the wall on the border between squares. The wall doesn't need to stand vertically, so you can use it to form a bridge or set of stairs, for example. You must conjure the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 14, and 50 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section of the wall can be moved through, but the rubble created from it is difficult terrain.

Heightened (+2) The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 15.

spell->Clairvoyance.name: Clairvoyance
spell->Clairvoyance.description: You create an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} floating eye at a location within range (even if it's outside your line of sight or line of effect). The eye can't move, but you can see in all directions from that point as if using your normal visual senses.

spell->Creation.name: Creation
spell->Creation.description:
You conjure a temporary object from magical energy. It must consist of earthen or plant-derived matter (such as wood, paper, brick, or stone) and be 5 cubic feet or smaller. It can't rely on intricate artistry or complex moving parts, never fulfills a cost or the like, and can't be made of precious materials or materials with a rarity of uncommon or higher. It is obviously temporarily conjured, and thus can't be sold or passed off as a genuine item. The spell gains the appropriate trait for the item created, typically earth, plant, or wood.

Heightened (5th) The item is metal and can include common minerals, like feldspar or quartz. The spell gains the metal trait if used to create a metal object

spell->Engrave Memory.name: Engrave Memory
spell->Engrave Memory.description:
You store memories inside a stone. This memory can convey up to 10 minutes of material. When you Cast this Spell, choose a command word. Doing so creates a carved symbol on the stone that hints at the word. Any creature can access the memories stored within the stone by using an action to speak the command word.

As it imparts the memories, the stone crumbles to dust, but the memory is infallibly available to the creature that activated the stone for the next 24 hours. After that time, the creature's normal capacity for memory must be relied upon to recall the stone's imparted memory. It's up to the GM what benefit the imparted memory grants, from circumstance bonuses to checks related to the memory or clear information on subjects the memory covers.

spell->Fly.name: Fly
spell->Fly.description:
The target can soar through the air, gaining a fly Speed equal to its Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.MuRBCiZn5IKeaoxi]{Spell Effect: Fly}

Heightened (7th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

spell->Grasping Earth.name: Grasping Earth
spell->Grasping Earth.description:
Handlike protrusions of rock and soil grab and bury creatures. Each creature in the area when you cast the spell, and each creature that ends its turn in the area during the spell's duration, must attempt a Fortitude save. The first time each round you Sustain this spell, each creature still @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the earth takes @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage, and each creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by the earth takes @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]] damage. A creature can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}, rolling against your spell DC.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is grabbed by the earth.

Critical Failure The creature is restrained by the earth.

Heightened (+2) The bludgeoning damage dealt when you Sustain this spell increases by 1d6 for grabbed creatures and 2d6 for restrained creatures.

spell->Mountain Resilience.name: Mountain Resilience
spell->Mountain Resilience.description:
The target's skin hardens like the stone of a mountain face. It gains resistance 5 to physical damage, except adamantine. Each time the target is hit by a bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing attack, mountain resilience's duration decreases by 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JHpYudY14g0H4VWU]{Spell Effect: Mountain Resilience}

Heightened (6th) The resistance increases to 10.

Heightened (8th) The resistance increases to 15.

Heightened (10th) The resistance increases to 20.

spell->Shape Stone (At Will).name: Shape Stone (At Will)
spell->Shape Stone (At Will).description:
You shape the stone into a rough shape of your choice. The shaping process is too crude to produce intricate parts, fine details, moving pieces, or the like. Any creatures standing atop the stone when you reshape it must each attempt a Reflex save or Acrobatics check.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} atop the stone.

Critical Failure The creature falls off the stone (if applicable) and lands Prone.
spell->Shape Stone (At Will).target: cube of stone 10 feet across or smaller

spell->Translocate.name: Translocate
spell->Translocate.description:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

spell->Translocate (At Will).name: Translocate (At Will)
spell->Translocate (At Will).description:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

spell->Earthbind (At Will).name: Earthbind (At Will)
spell->Earthbind (At Will).description:
Using the weight of earth, you hamper a target's flight, with effects based on its Fortitude save. If the creature reaches the ground safely, it doesn't take falling damage.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target falls safely up to 120 feet.

Failure The target falls safely up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it can't Fly, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target falls safely up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it can't Fly, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 minute.

spell->Haste.name: Haste
spell->Haste.description:
Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}

spell->One with Stone.name: One with Stone
spell->One with Stone.description:
You can either transform into a stone or merge with stone. While transformed, you can't move or affect anything outside the stone, but you can cast spells as long as they don't require line of effect beyond the stone. You can Dismiss this spell.

  • Merge with Stone The spell's duration is 10 minutes. While casting the spell, you must touch a stone with enough volume to fit you and your possessions or the spell is disrupted. While merged, you can hear, but not see, what's going on outside the stone. If the stone takes damage while you're inside it, you're expelled from the stone and take 10d6 damage. Magic passage expels you without dealing damage. The spell ends if you're ever outside the stone.
  • Turn into a Stone The spell's duration is 8 hours. You become a Large stone. Perception checks don't reveal your true nature, but a successful Nature or Survival check against your spell DC reveals that you appear to be a stone that is strangely new to the area. While in this form, you can observe everything around you, using your normal senses. As a stone, your AC is 23, and only status bonuses, status penalties, circumstance bonuses, and circumstance penalties affect you. Any successes and critical successes you roll on Reflex saves are failures

spell->Knock.name: Knock
spell->Knock.description:
You make the target easier to open. Knock grants a +4 status bonus to any creature that tries to open the target door, lock, or container with an Athletics or a Thievery check. You can attempt a Thievery check to open the target as part of casting knock, and you add your level even if you're untrained.

Knock counteracts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Azoh0BSoCASrA1lr]{Lock}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.OSapCU8heNHst21y]{Spell Effect: Knock}

spell->Magnetic Attraction.name: Magnetic Attraction
spell->Magnetic Attraction.description:
You adjust your magnetic polarity, plucking daggers from hands and coins from belts. The targeted objects fly to your location, letting you catch them easily in your hands, or dropping to the ground at your position, at your discretion. Unattended objects fly to you automatically. If you target secured objects or those in another creature's possession (such as sheathed weapons), you must attempt to Disarm the creature of the metal objects, making a spell attack roll instead of an Athletics check to do so.

Instead of drawing the objects to yourself, you can polarize a single metal object within range, designating it as a lodestone and causing the metal objects to fly to it instead. The lodestone must be at least three times the total Bulk of the targeted metal objects. Objects will stick to the lodestone for 1 minute, though they can be wrenched away with an Interact action.
spell->Magnetic Attraction.target: up to 10 metal objects with a total Bulk of 1 or less

spell->Magnetic Repulsion.name: Magnetic Repulsion
spell->Magnetic Repulsion.description:
You adjust your magnetic polarity, causing metal objects to jump and shudder away from you. Attacks made with metal objects against you take a -1 status penalty, and the squares adjacent to you are difficult terrain for creatures wearing metal armor. For creatures made entirely of metal, the penalty to their attack rolls is -2 and the squares adjacent to you are greater difficult terrain.

While this spell is active, you require an additional Interact action before using a metal object (including to Strike with a metal weapon), and if you're wearing metal armor, you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

Heightened (+3) The status penalty to attack rolls increases by 1.

spell->Pave Ground.name: Pave Ground
spell->Pave Ground.description:
You even out the ground and push aside low obstacles. Non-magical difficult terrain or greater difficult terrain composed of earth, rubble, sand, and the like in the area becomes normal terrain. You can attempt a counteract check against magical difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain composed of earthen materials in the area, too, making it normal terrain for the duration if you succeed. The ground doesn't change quickly enough to cause anyone to lose footing, and it doesn't clear concealing features enough to make them non-concealing. At the GM's discretion, if you use this spell on "ground" that has no underlying surface to flatten and clear, such as ice on the surface of a lake, the spell fails.

Heightened (4th) The area increases to a 120-foot line along the ground.

Heightened (6th) The area increases to a 500-foot line along the ground.

spell->See the Unseen.name: See the Unseen
spell->See the Unseen.description:
Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}

spell->Shatter (At Will).name: Shatter (At Will)
spell->Shatter (At Will).description:
A high-frequency sonic attack shatters a nearby object. You deal 2d10 sonic damage to the object, ignoring the object's Hardness if it is 4 or lower.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d10, and the Hardness the spell ignores increases by 2.

spell->Summon Elemental (Earth Only).name: Summon Elemental (Earth Only)
spell->Summon Elemental (Earth Only).description:
You summon a creature that has the elemental trait and whose level is 1 or lower to fight for you.

Heightened As listed in the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.S55aqwWIzpQRFhcq.JournalEntryPage.8gcp880pEWZ9VPnF]{summon} trait.

spell->Ant Haul.name: Ant Haul
spell->Ant Haul.description:
You reinforce the target's musculoskeletal system to bear more weight. The target can carry 3 more Bulk than normal before becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.D5mg6Tc7Jzrj6ro7]{Encumbered} and up to a maximum of 6 more Bulk.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.5yCL7InrJDHpaQjz]{Spell Effect: Ant Haul}

spell->Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
spell->Detect Magic.description:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

spell->Mending.name: Mending
spell->Mending.description:
You repair the target item. You restore 5 Hit Points per spell rank to the target, potentially removing the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} condition if this repairs it past the item's Broken Threshold. You can't replace lost pieces or repair an object that's been completely destroyed.

Heightened (2nd) You can target a non-magical object of 1 Bulk or less.

Heightened (3rd) You can target a non-magical object of 2 Bulk or less, or a magical object of 1 Bulk or less.
spell->Mending.target: non-magical object of light Bulk or less

spell->Quick Sort.name: Quick Sort
spell->Quick Sort.description:
You magically sort a group of objects into neat stacks or piles. You can sort the objects in two different ways. The first option is to separate them into different piles depending on an easily observed factor, such as color or shape. Alternatively, you can sort the objects into ordered stacks depending on a clearly indicated notation, such as a page number, title, or date. The objects sort themselves throughout the duration, though it takes less time per object to sort a smaller number of objects, down to a single round for 30 or fewer objects.

Heightened (3rd) The spell can sort up to 500 objects in a minute, or 75 objects in a round.
spell->Quick Sort.target: up to 200 unattended objects in range, each of light Bulk or less

spell->Read Aura.name: Read Aura
spell->Read Aura.description:
You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.J6OhRNSN23KzOPRL]{Spell Effect: Read Aura}

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

spell->Scatter Scree.name: Scatter Scree
spell->Scatter Scree.description:
A jumble of rocks cascades into the area. The scattering rocks deal 2d4 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex save). The ground in the area becomes difficult terrain for the duration of the spell. A creature can Interact to clear a square of this scree.

If you cast this spell again, any previous scatter scree you've cast ends.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

spell->Sigil.name: Sigil
spell->Sigil.description:
You harmlessly place your unique magical sigil, which is about 1 square inch in size, on the targeted creature or object. The mark can be visible or invisible, and you can change it from one state to another by using an Interact action to touch the target. The mark can be scrubbed or scraped off with 5 minutes of work. If it's on a creature, it fades naturally over the course of a week. The time before the mark fades increases depending on your heightened rank.

Heightened (3rd) The sigil instead fades after 1 month.

Heightened (5th) The sigil instead fades after 1 year.

Heightened (7th) The sigil never fades.

spell->Telekinetic Hand.name: Telekinetic Hand
spell->Telekinetic Hand.description:
You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.
spell->Telekinetic Hand.target: 1 unattended object of light Bulk or less

consumable->Wand of Exploding Earth (Ran.name: Wand of Exploding Earth (Rank 8)
consumable->Wand of Exploding Earth (Ran.consumableSpellDescription:
You throw a hard-packed ball of earth and stone at a creature, and the projectile explodes upon impact. Attempt a spell attack against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 4d6 bludgeoning damage plus 1d6 bludgeoning splash damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the splash damage, and the target you hit must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 2d6, and the splash damage increases by 1d6.
consumable->Wand of Exploding Earth (Ran.description:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.v89KwyaBd6g5rWVS]{Exploding Earth}

This baton is about a foot long and contains a single spell. The appearance typically relates to the spell within.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated rank.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of the spell at the listed rank.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

consumable->Wand of Vitrifying Blast (Ra.name: Wand of Vitrifying Blast (Rank 8)
consumable->Wand of Vitrifying Blast (Ra.consumableSpellDescription:
You launch a cone of glass shards, which embed in creatures to turn them partially to glass. The shards deal 8d6 piercing damage to creatures in the area, based on each creature's saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and gains weakness 3 to sonic and bludgeoning damage for 1 round.

Failure The target takes full damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}, and gains weakness to sonic and bludgeoning damage. The weakness is equal to 3 × the slowed value it has from this spell. The target must attempt a Fortitude save at the end of each of its turns; this ongoing save has the incapacitation trait. On a failed save, the creature's slowed value increases by 1 (or by 2 on a critical failure), to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 3}. A successful save reduces the creature's slowed value by 1 (or by 2 on a critical success). If the creature ends its turn with a slowed value of 0, the effect ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is initially @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UFfItbPq9cVq3LNa]{Spell Effect: Vitrifying Blast}

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.
consumable->Wand of Vitrifying Blast (Ra.description:
@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.g2V4ID0pl1ZGAxZj]{Vitrifying Blast}

This baton is about a foot long and contains a single spell. The appearance typically relates to the spell within.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated rank.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of the spell at the listed rank.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

action->Craft Crystal Wand.name: Craft Crystal Wand
action->Craft Crystal Wand.description:
Frequency twice per day

Effect The vault builder spends 10 minutes creating a magic wand out of radioactive green crystal, containing any 8th-rank or lower earth spell of their choice. The wand can be used by other creatures, but it crumbles to sand at the end of the day and has no monetary value. The vault builder can expend both daily uses to instead make a +3 greater striking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.a8YCTjKnXySKpU5C]{Major Staff of Earth}.

action->Item Caster.name: Item Caster
action->Item Caster.description: Cern can Cast a Spell from any item (such as a staff or wand) as though it were on their spell list, but the spell can be 8th-rank or lower.

action->+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

action->+4 Status to All Saves vs. Earth.name: +4 Status to All Saves vs. Earth

action->Constraining Crystal.name: Constraining Crystal
action->Constraining Crystal.description: When the vault builder deals damage with a claw Strike, glowing green crystals cluster at the site of the attack. The target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:29|options:inflicts:clumsy,inflicts:petrified] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 hour (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} on a critical failure). If the creature is already clumsy due to constraining crystal, additional failures increase that clumsy value instead, to a maximum of clumsy 4. A target that fails its save while clumsy 4 is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified} with an unlimited duration.

action->Crystal Burst.name: Crystal Burst
action->Crystal Burst.description: An explosion of razor-sharp splinters deals @Damage[24d6[piercing]|options:area-damage|traits:item:frequency:limited] damage in a @Template[burst|distance:30] within 120 feet, with a @Check[reflex|dc:44|basic|options:area-effect] save. The vault keeper can't use Crystal Burst again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Crystal Burst]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Earth Glide.name: Earth Glide
action->Earth Glide.description: The vault builder can Burrow through any earthen matter, including rock. When they do so, the vault builder moves at their full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of their passing.

action->Repair Ley Pylon.name: Repair Ley Pylon
action->Repair Ley Pylon.description:
Requirements Cern isn't suffering from a negative condition or taking persistent damage

Effect Cern touches an adjacent ley pylon that has been reduced to 0 HP and utters a brief invocation in Petran. The ley pylon regains @Damage[35[healing]]{35 HP}. Each pylon can be repaired only once.

spell->True Target.name: True Target
spell->True Target.description:
You delve into the possible futures of the next few seconds to understand all the ways your foe might avoid harm, then cast out a vision of that future to those around you. Designate a creature. The first time each target makes an attack roll against that creature during true target's duration, the attacker rolls twice and uses the better result. The attacker also ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the designated creature being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.HuvucQ5nfpuVWNrw]{Spell Effect: True Target}

spell->Disintegrate.name: Disintegrate
spell->Disintegrate.description:
A black tracer bolt flies toward your target, and upon making contact intensifies into a powerful destructive beam. Make a spell attack against the target. If you hit an object or force construct (such as a wall of force), it's destroyed with no save unless it's an artifact or similarly powerful. A single casting can destroy no more than a 10-foot cube of matter. If you hit a creature, it takes 12d10 damage (no damage type) with a basic Fortitude save. If you critically hit, the target gets a result one degree of success worse than the outcome of its Fortitude save. A creature reduced to 0 HP is blasted to fine powder; its gear remains.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d10.
spell->Disintegrate.target: 1 creature, unattended object, or force construct

spell->Disintegrate.name: Disintegrate
spell->Disintegrate.description:
A black tracer bolt flies toward your target, and upon making contact intensifies into a powerful destructive beam. Make a spell attack against the target. If you hit an object or force construct (such as a wall of force), it's destroyed with no save unless it's an artifact or similarly powerful. A single casting can destroy no more than a 10-foot cube of matter. If you hit a creature, it takes 12d10 damage (no damage type) with a basic Fortitude save. If you critically hit, the target gets a result one degree of success worse than the outcome of its Fortitude save. A creature reduced to 0 HP is blasted to fine powder; its gear remains.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d10.
spell->Disintegrate.target: 1 creature, unattended object, or force construct

spell->Repulsion.name: Repulsion
spell->Repulsion.description:
You manifest an aura that prevents creatures from approaching you. When casting the spell, you can make the area any radius you choose, up to 40 feet. A creature must attempt a Will save if it's within the area when you Cast the Spell or as soon as it enters the area while the spell is in effect. Once a creature has attempted the save, it uses the same result for that casting of repulsion. Any restrictions on a creature's movement apply only if it voluntarily moves toward you. For example, if you move closer to a creature, it doesn't then need to move away.

Critical Success The creature's movement is not restricted.

Success The creature treats each square in the area as difficult terrain when moving closer to you.

Failure The creature can't move closer to you within the area.

spell->Vibrant Pattern.name: Vibrant Pattern
spell->Vibrant Pattern.description:
You create a pattern of lights that pulses with intensity. Creatures are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} while inside the pattern. In addition, a creature must attempt a Will saving throw if it's inside the pattern when you cast it, enters the pattern, ends its turn within the pattern, or uses a Seek or Interact action on the pattern. A creature currently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} by the pattern doesn't need to attempt new saving throws.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Blinded by the pattern. If it exits the pattern, it can attempt a new save to recover from the Blinded condition at the end of each of its turns, to a maximum duration of 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is Blinded for 1 minute.

spell->Impaling Spike.name: Impaling Spike
spell->Impaling Spike.description:
You conjure a spike that thrusts up from the earth beneath a target creature, potentially impaling it. The spike is made of cold iron and deals 8d6 piercing damage. The target must attempt a Reflex save.

Critical Success The target dodges the spike and is unaffected.

Success The target is struck by the spike and takes half damage.

Failure The target is impaled through a leg or another nonvital body part. The creature takes full damage and, if it's standing on solid ground, becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. It can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} (the DC is your spell DC). While it remains impaled, it takes damage from any weakness to cold iron it has at the end of each of its turns.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is impaled through a vital organ or its center of mass, taking double damage, and it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} as long as it's impaled.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

spell->Slither.name: Slither
spell->Slither.description:
A mass of snakes made of shadow rise up to capture creatures in the area. Each creature in the area when you Cast the Spell takes 3d6 piercing damage and 1d6 persistent poison damage from a biting snake, and it's grabbed or restrained depending on its Reflex save. A creature that ends its turn in the area must also attempt this save, even if it's already grabbed or restrained by the snakes. You can Dismiss the spell.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by a snake. The snakes' [[/act escape]] DC is equal to your spell DC. A creature can attack a snake to release the creature. A snake's AC is equal to your spell DC, and it's destroyed if it takes 12 or more damage at once. New snakes continually regrow as long as the spell lasts, so destroying snakes doesn't prevent slither from capturing more creatures.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by a snake.

Heightened (+2) The persistent poison damage increases by 1d6 and snake HP increases by 6.

spell->Telekinetic Haul.name: Telekinetic Haul
spell->Telekinetic Haul.description: You move the target up to 20 feet, potentially suspending it in midair. When you Sustain the Spell, you can do so again, or you can shift your telekinetic focus to a different eligible target within range, moving it instead.
spell->Telekinetic Haul.target: 1 unattended object of up to 80 Bulk with no dimension longer than 20 feet

spell->Flicker.name: Flicker
spell->Flicker.description:
You flicker quickly between your current plane and another. You gain resistance 5 to all damage, except force. At the end of each of your turns, you automatically teleport 10 feet in a random direction, as determined by the GM. You can Sustain the spell to teleport in this way.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ZlsuhS9J0S3PuvCO]{Spell Effect: Flicker}

Heightened (+2) The resistance increases by 3.

spell->Fly.name: Fly
spell->Fly.description:
The target can soar through the air, gaining a fly Speed equal to its Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.MuRBCiZn5IKeaoxi]{Spell Effect: Fly}

Heightened (7th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

spell->Shape Stone.name: Shape Stone
spell->Shape Stone.description:
You shape the stone into a rough shape of your choice. The shaping process is too crude to produce intricate parts, fine details, moving pieces, or the like. Any creatures standing atop the stone when you reshape it must each attempt a Reflex save or Acrobatics check.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} atop the stone.

Critical Failure The creature falls off the stone (if applicable) and lands Prone.
spell->Shape Stone.target: cube of stone 10 feet across or smaller

spell->Aqueous Orb.name: Aqueous Orb
spell->Aqueous Orb.description:
A sphere of water 10 feet in diameter forms in an unoccupied space in range, either on the ground or on the surface of a liquid.

When you Cast this Spell and each time you Sustain it, you can roll the orb, moving it up to 10 feet along the ground or the surface of a liquid.

The orb can move through the spaces of any creatures or obstacles that wouldn't stop the flow of water. It extinguishes non-magical fires it moves through of its size or smaller, and it attempts to counteract any magical fires it moves through. If it fails to counteract a given fire, it can't counteract that fire for the duration of the spell.

The orb can engulf Large or smaller creatures it moves through, and it can contain as many creatures as fit in its space. The orb can try to engulf the same creature only once per turn, even if you roll it onto a creature's space more than once. Any Large or smaller creature whose space the orb tries to move through can attempt a Reflex save.

Success The creature can either let the orb pass (remaining in its space or moving out of the orb's path into a space of the creature's choice) or allow itself to be pushed in front of the orb to the end of the orb's movement.

Failure The creature is engulfed in the orb. It moves along with the orb and must hold its breath or begin suffocating (unless it can breathe in water). An engulfed Medium or smaller creature and anyone trying to affect that creature follow the normal rules for aquatic battles. An engulfed Large creature is usually big enough that parts of it stick out from the water, and it can reach out of the water. The creature can get free either by Swimming with a successful @Check[athletics|traits:action:swim|dc:10] check or by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escaping} against your spell DC. A freed creature exits the orb's space and can immediately breathe.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature can't Swim to get free.

spell->Haste.name: Haste
spell->Haste.description:
Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}

spell->Invisibility.name: Invisibility
spell->Invisibility.description:
Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

spell->Mist.name: Mist
spell->Mist.description: You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}, and all creatures outside the mist become concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.

spell->Revealing Light.name: Revealing Light
spell->Revealing Light.description:
A wave of magical light washes over the area. You choose the appearance of the light, such as colorful, heatless flames or sparkling motes. A creature affected by revealing light is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}. If the creature was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead. If the creature was already concealed for any other reason, it is no longer concealed.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The light affects the creature for 2 rounds.

Failure The light affects the creature for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The light affects the creature for 10 minutes.

spell->Web.name: Web
spell->Web.description:
You create a sticky web in the area that impedes creatures' movement. Squares filled with the web are difficult terrain. Each time a creature in the web begins to use a move action or enters the web during a move action it's using, it must attempt an @Check[athletics] check or Reflex save against your spell DC to avoid taking a circumstance penalty to its Speeds or becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. A creature that gets out of the web ceases to take a circumstance penalty to its Speed from the web. Each square can be cleared of the web by a single attack or effect that deals at least 5 slashing damage or 1 fire damage. A square has AC 5, and it automatically fails its saving throws.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected, and it doesn't need to attempt further Athletics checks or saving throws against the web this turn. If it used an Athletics check, it clears the web from every square it leaves during its movement.

Success The creature is unaffected during its action. If it used an Athletics check, it clears the web from every square it leaves during its movement.

Failure The creature takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the start of its next turn.

Critical Failure The creature is immobilized until the start of its next turn, after which it takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. It can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} to remove its immobilized condition.

Heightened (4th) The spell's area increases to a @Template[burst|distance:20], and its range increases to 60 feet.

spell->Carryall.name: Carryall
spell->Carryall.description:
A small platform of magical force materializes adjacent to you to carry cargo. It is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} or has a ghostly appearance, is 2 feet in diameter, and follows 5 feet behind you, floating just above the ground. It holds up to 5 Bulk of objects (if they can fit on it). Any objects atop the platform fall to the ground when the spell ends. You can Sustain the spell to move the platform up to 30 feet along the ground, to make it stay in place, or to have it return to you and resume following you. The spell ends if a creature tries to ride atop the platform, if the platform is overloaded, if anyone tries to lift or force the platform higher above the ground, or if you move more than 60 feet away from the platform.

Heightened (4th) The platform can carry 10 Bulk, creatures can ride atop it, and it can hover in the air, not just on the ground

spell->Caustic Blast.name: Caustic Blast
spell->Caustic Blast.description:
You fling a large glob of acid that immediately detonates, spraying nearby creatures. Creatures in the area take 1d8 acid damage with a basic Reflex save; on a critical failure, the creature also takes @Damage[(1+floor((@item.rank -1)/2))[persistent,acid]] damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage on a critical failure increases by 1.

spell->Daze.name: Daze
spell->Daze.description:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

spell->Gentle Landing.name: Gentle Landing
spell->Gentle Landing.description:
Trigger a creature within range is falling

You raise a magical updraft to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

spell->Grease.name: Grease
spell->Grease.description:
You conjure grease, choosing an area or target.

  • Area [4 contiguous 5-foot squares] All solid ground in the area is covered with grease. Each creature standing on the greasy surface must succeed at a Reflex save or an Acrobatics check against your spell DC or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. Creatures using an action to move onto the greasy surface during the spell's duration must attempt either a Reflex save or an Acrobatics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.M76ycLAqHoAgbcej]{Balance}. A creature that Steps or Crawls doesn't have to attempt a check or save.
  • Target [1 object of Bulk 1 or less] If you Cast the Spell on an unattended object, anyone trying to pick up the object must succeed at an Acrobatics check or Reflex save against your spell DC to do so. If you target an attended object, the creature that has the object must attempt an Acrobatics check or Reflex save. On a failure, the holder or wielder takes a –2 circumstance penalty to all checks that involve using the object; on a critical failure, the holder or wielder releases the item. The object lands in an adjacent square of the GM's choice. If you Cast this Spell on a worn object, the wearer gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against attempts to grapple them.

spell->Puff of Poison.name: Puff of Poison
spell->Puff of Poison.description:
You exhale a shimmering cloud of toxic breath at an enemy's face. The target takes 1d4 poison damage and @Damage[(ceil(@item.level/2))d4[persistent,poison]], depending on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The target takes half initial damage and no persistent damage.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage.

Critical Failure The target takes double initial and persistent damage.

Heightened (+2) The initial poison damage increases by 1d4, and the persistent poison damage increases by 1d4.

spell->Shield.name: Shield
spell->Shield.description:
You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

spell->Telekinetic Hand.name: Telekinetic Hand
spell->Telekinetic Hand.description:
You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.
spell->Telekinetic Hand.target: 1 unattended object of light Bulk or less

consumable->Clockwork Wand.name: Clockwork Wand
consumable->Clockwork Wand.description:
The clockwork wand is a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.vJZ49cgi8szuQXAD]{Magic Wand} containing the last 2nd-rank innate spell the clockwork mage cast (the GM determines the spell randomly if it has not cast any eligible spells). The spells are placed within the wand while the mage is created, and the creator can substitute other arcane spells of the appropriate rank.

This baton is about a foot long and contains a single spell. The appearance typically relates to the spell within.

Activate Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day, plus overcharge

Effect You Cast the Spell at the indicated rank.

Craft Requirements Supply a casting of the spell at the listed rank.

Note: To create a scroll or wand of a specific spell, drag the spell from the compendium or compendium browser into the inventory of a PC, NPC, or loot actor.

action->Clockwork Wand.name: Clockwork Wand
action->Clockwork Wand.description:
The clockwork mage uses a mechanical wand as a focus to channel magical energy. This wand is built into the clockwork mage's chest, with only the crystal at the end exposed. The mage can Interact to the remove the wand, or someone else can remove it with a DC 39 Thievery check to [[/act disable-device dc=39]]. The clockwork mage becomes unable to cast any spells except cantrips while the wand is removed.

When removed, the clockwork wand is a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.vJZ49cgi8szuQXAD]{Magic Wand} containing the last 2nd-rank innate spell the clockwork mage cast (the GM determines the spell randomly if the mage has not cast any eligible spells). The spells are placed within the wand while the mage is created, and the creator can substitute other arcane spells of the appropriate rank.

action->Energize Clockwork Wand.name: Energize Clockwork Wand
action->Energize Clockwork Wand.description:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect The clockwork mage regains a spell it has already cast that day. It must spend 1 hour of its operational time, or 2 hours if the spell is 3rd rank or higher.

Collapsing Vestibule.name: Collapsing Vestibule
Collapsing Vestibule.description: A weak point in the barrier between the Universe and the Plane of Earth compromises the stability of the entire chamber.
Collapsing Vestibule.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:36] or @Check[nature|dc:36] (expert) twice to seal the rift between planes, or @Check[stealth|dc:34] to pass through the chamber without triggering the trap
Collapsing Vestibule.reset: Once all creatures have left the area, the hazard deactivates and the stone maulers disappear, but the hazard resets after 1 minute.
Collapsing Vestibule.routine: (2 actions) The hazard uses each of its actions to summon an elite @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.ToteDLIM7jCyHwDH]{Stone Mauler}. Once the hazard has summoned a total of three stone maulers, it can’t summon another until the hazard resets. Alternatively, the hazard can use one of its actions to reassemble a mauler that has been reduced to 0 Hit Points. A reassembled stone mauler appears in the space it was destroyed with 100 Hit Points and is stunned 1. If the trap is disabled, any summoned stone maulers disappear as they return to the Plane of Earth.

action->Rockfall.name: Rockfall
action->Rockfall.description:
Trigger A creature enters area E2 or fails an Arcana or Nature check to disable the trap

Effect The ceiling of the chamber partially collapses. Each creature in the area takes @Damage[(3d12+18)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:37|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:prone,inflicts:restrained] save) from falling rubble. On a critical failure, the creature also falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} ([[/act escape dc=37]]) as it is pinned beneath a rock. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Corundumite.name: Corundumite
Corundumite.publicNotes:
Corundumites are flying earth elementals that look like faceted red or blue gemstones. Drawn to veins rich with rubies, sapphires, and other precious stones, corundumites regard themselves as the guardians of the earth's riches, attacking those who mine or even examine the uncut gems in their domains. They can be hostile to travelers who have gemstones in their possession, but those who carry no such stones—or who surrender their gems as recompense for the slight—are usually allowed to pass unharmed. Why corundumites are so protective of the stones in their care remains unknown, though those who have spoken with the elementals report that they seem to regard the gems not as symbols of wealth, but rather as living, thinking beings.

Gem Body

When it dies, a corundumite transforms into an inert—and highly valuable—corundum gemstone such as a ruby or sapphire. An intact gemstone harvested from a dead corundumite can be worth as much as 2,000 gp, provided it's in good condition. Unfortunately, not every battle leaves behind a perfectly preserved gemstone. If the damage that reduced the corundumite to 0 Hit Points was bludgeoning, force, or sonic damage, the gem smashes into 2d6 fragments, each of which is worth only 100 gp.

action->Gemsense.name: Gemsense
action->Gemsense.description: A corundumite can sense gems within 60 feet as if using the scent ability.

action->Glow.name: Glow
action->Glow.description: 20 feet. The aura sheds dim light.

action->Cold Ray.name: Cold Ray
action->Cold Ray.description:
The corundumite fires a beam of freezing blue light in a @Template[type:line|distance:60]. Any creature in the area takes @Damage[6d10[cold]|options:area-damage] damage and must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:38|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:immobilized,inflicts:petrified] save. The corundumite can't use Cold Ray on its next turn.

Critical Success No effect.

Success Half damage.

Failure Full damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round.

Critical Failure Full damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified} for 1 round. While petrified, the creature is transformed into solid ice instead of stone and gains weakness 5 to fire.

action->Earth Glide.name: Earth Glide
action->Earth Glide.description: The corundumite can Burrow through any earthen matter, including rock. When it does so, the corundumite moves at its full burrow Speed, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.

action->Fire Ray.name: Fire Ray
action->Fire Ray.description:
The corundumite fires a beam of blinding red light in a @Template[type:line|distance:60]. Any creature in the area takes deals @Damage[8d10[fire]|options:area-damage] damage and must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:38|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:dazzled,inflicts:blinded] DC save. The corundumite can't use Fire Ray on its next turn.

Critical Success No effect.

Success Half damage.

Failure Full damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Critical Failure Full damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

action->Raking Shot.name: Raking Shot
action->Raking Shot.description: The corundumite uses Cold Ray or Fire Ray and then Flies in a straight line in a direction perpendicular to its ray. During this movement, the ray moves with the corundumite. When the ray enters a creature's space, that creature is affected by the ray. The corundumite can't use Raking Shot again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Raking Shot]]{1d4 rounds}.

Crushing Threshold.name: Crushing Threshold
Crushing Threshold.description: The ceilings of four alcoves slam down, threatening to crush everything inside.
Crushing Threshold.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:40] (master) twice to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock} of the iron door or @Check[athletics|dc:44] (master) to [[/act force-open]] the door
Crushing Threshold.reset: Once the ceiling of the northernmost alcove descends, all four ceilings return to their original positions, the wall of force sealing the northern alcove disappears, and the hazard resets. Opening the iron door (even from the opposite side) permanently disables the hazard.
Crushing Threshold.routine: (1 action) The ceiling of one of the four alcoves—starting with the southernmost alcove and moving one alcove north each round—slams down with incredible force. A creature bracing the ceiling can prevent it from descending by making a successful @Check[athletics|dc:44] check, but the creature must repeat this check each round. The ceiling drops if the creature fails the check or leaves the alcove. Creatures and objects in an alcove when a ceiling drops each take @Damage[(6d12+41)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:44|basic|options:area-effect|options:inflicts:prone] save). A creature that takes this damage also falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The contents of the alcove are then teleported to the secret hallway north of area H2, leaving the alcove filled with nothing but a block of solid stone.

action->Welcome to the Coils.name: Welcome to the Coils
action->Welcome to the Coils.description:
Trigger A creature enters the northernmost alcove

Effect Zyphaniss's telepathic chuckle echoes in the minds of all creatures in the area. A 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Iela4GgVeO3LfAo]{Wall of Force} appears across the entrance of the northern alcove. Any creature in that alcove can attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:38] save to leap out of the alcove before the wall of force traps them inside. The hazard rolls initiative

spell->Hidden Mind.name: Hidden Mind
spell->Hidden Mind.description:
Powerful wards hide a creature from magic that would spy on it or affect its mind. The target gains a +4 status bonus to saves against mental effects. Hidden mind attempts to counteract any detection, revelation, and scrying effects as if its spell rank were 1 higher than its actual rank. On a success, the effect functions normally except that it detects nothing about the target and its possessions. For instance, detect magic would still detect other magic in the area, but not any magic on the target.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.DBaMtFHRPEg1JeLs]{Spell Effect: Hidden Mind}

spell->Quandary.name: Quandary
spell->Quandary.description:
You transport the target into an extraplanar puzzle room of mysterious origin, locking them there. Once each turn as a single action, the target can attempt an @Check[occultism] check, @Check[perception] check, or @Check[thievery] check against your spell DC to solve the puzzle. Teleportation effects can't carry the target outside the puzzle room unless they can also traverse the planes, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport}. When the spell ends, the target returns to the space it occupied when it was banished, or to the nearest space if the original is now filled.

Critical Success The target solves the puzzle and escapes.

Success The target is on the right path to the solution. If it was already on the right path, it solves the puzzle and escapes.

Failure The target makes no progress toward a solution.

Critical Failure The target makes no progress and, if it was on the right path, it no longer is.

spell->Warp Mind.name: Warp Mind
spell->Warp Mind.description:
You scramble a creature's mental faculties and sensory input. The target must attempt a Will saving throw. Regardless of the result of that save, the target is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes. Warp mind's effects happen instantly, so @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} and other effects that counteract spells can't counteract them. However, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} rituals and abilities that can remove non-magical effects can still counteract the effects.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target spends the first action on its next turn with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} condition.

Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Confused permanently.

spell->Spirit Blast.name: Spirit Blast
spell->Spirit Blast.description:
