You concentrate ethereal energy and attack a creature's spirit, dealing 16d6 spirit damage with a basic Fortitude save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

spell->Vampiric Exsanguination.name: Vampiric Exsanguination
spell->Vampiric Exsanguination.description:
You draw in the blood and life force of other creatures through your outstretched arms. You deal 12d6 void damage to living creatures in the area with a basic Fortitude save.

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage a single creature takes from this spell; calculate these temporary Hit Points using the creature that took the most damage. You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

spell->Zealous Conviction.name: Zealous Conviction
spell->Zealous Conviction.description:
You bypass your targets' rational minds, instilling them with unshakable conviction and zeal. The targets each gain 12 temporary Hit Points and a +2 status bonus to Will saves against mental effects, as their faith overrides the signals from their own bodies and minds. If you tell a target to do something, it must comply with your request, though if it would normally find the task repugnant, it can attempt a Will save at the end of its turn each round due to the cognitive dissonance. On a success, it ends the spell's effects on itself entirely.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.nemThuhp3praALY6]{Spell Effect: Zealous Conviction}

Heightened (9th) The temporary Hit Points increase to 18, and the status bonus to Will saves increases to +3.

spell->Sending.name: Sending
spell->Sending.description: You send the creature a mental message of 25 words or fewer, and it can respond immediately with its own message of 25 words or fewer.

spell->Shadow Blast.name: Shadow Blast
spell->Shadow Blast.description:
Area varies

Defense @Check[reflex|basic|options:area-effect] or @Check[will|basic|options:area-effect] (target's choice)

You shape the shadow substance of the Netherworld into a blast. Choose @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[acid]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[cold]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[electricity]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[fire]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[force]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[piercing]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[slashing]|options:area-damage], @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[sonic]|options:area-damage], or @Damage[(@item.rank+1)d8[spirit]|options:area-damage] damage, and choose a @Template[cone|distance:30], a @Template[burst|distance:15] within 120 feet, or a @Template[line|distance:50]. The blast deals 6d8 damage of the type you chose to each creature in the area.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

spell->Confusion.name: Confusion
spell->Confusion.description:
You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Flicker.name: Flicker
spell->Flicker.description:
You flicker quickly between your current plane and another. You gain resistance 5 to all damage, except force. At the end of each of your turns, you automatically teleport 10 feet in a random direction, as determined by the GM. You can Sustain the spell to teleport in this way.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ZlsuhS9J0S3PuvCO]{Spell Effect: Flicker}

Heightened (+2) The resistance increases by 3.

spell->Vision of Death.name: Vision of Death
spell->Vision of Death.description:
You force the target to see a vision of its own death. It takes 8d6 mental damage with a Will save. If the target is reduced to 0 HP by this spell, its vision becomes reality and kills it instantly.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as it's frightened.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

spell->Enthrall.name: Enthrall
spell->Enthrall.description:
Your words fascinate your targets. You speak or sing without interruption throughout the casting and duration. Targets who notice your speech or song might give their undivided attention; each target must attempt a Will save. The GM might grant a circumstance bonus (to a maximum of +4) if the target is of an opposing religion, ancestry, or political leaning, or is otherwise unlikely to agree with what you're saying.

Each creature that comes within range has to attempt a save when you Sustain the spell. If you're speaking, enthrall gains the linguistic trait.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and notices that you tried to use magic.

Success The target needn't pay attention but doesn't notice you tried to use magic (it might notice others are enthralled).

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} with you. It can attempt another Will save if it witnesses actions or speech with which it disagrees. If it succeeds, it's no longer fascinated and is temporarily immune for 1 hour. If the target is subject to a hostile act, or if another creature succeeds at a Diplomacy or Intimidation check against it, the fascination ends immediately.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target can't attempt a save to end the fascination if it disagrees with you.

spell->Heroism.name: Heroism
spell->Heroism.description:
You unlock the target's inner heroism, granting it a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, Perception checks, saving throws, and skill checks.

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +2.

Heightened (9th) The status bonus increases to +3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.l9HRQggofFGIxEse]{Spell Effect: Heroism}

spell->Levitate.name: Levitate
spell->Levitate.description:
You defy gravity and levitate the target 5 feet off the ground. You can Sustain the spell to move the target up or down 10 feet. A creature floating in the air from levitate takes a –2 circumstance penalty to attack rolls. A floating creature can spend an Interact action to stabilize itself and negate this penalty for the remainder of its turn. If the target is adjacent to a fixed object or terrain of suitable stability, it can move across the surface by climbing (if the surface is vertical, like a wall) or crawling (if the surface is horizontal, such as a ceiling). The GM determines which surfaces can be climbed or crawled across.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.JqrTrvwV7pYStMXz]{Spell Effect: Levitate}

spell->Blur.name: Blur
spell->Blur.description: The target's form appears blurry. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

spell->Dispel Magic.name: Dispel Magic
spell->Dispel Magic.description: You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.
spell->Dispel Magic.target: 1 spell effect or unattended magic item

spell->Invisibility.name: Invisibility
spell->Invisibility.description:
Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

spell->Stupefy.name: Stupefy
spell->Stupefy.description:
You dull the target's mind, depending on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} for 1 minute.

spell->Command.name: Command
spell->Command.description:
You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Daze.name: Daze
spell->Daze.description:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

spell->Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
spell->Detect Magic.description:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

spell->Forbidding Ward.name: Forbidding Ward
spell->Forbidding Ward.description:
You ward an ally against the attacks and hostile spells from the target enemy. The target ally gains a +1 status bonus to Armor Class and saving throws against the target enemy's attacks, spells, and other effects.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ctMxYPGEpstvhW9C]{Spell Effect: Forbidding Ward}

Heightened (6th) The status bonus increases to +2.

spell->Force Barrage.name: Force Barrage
spell->Force Barrage.description:
You fire a shard of solidified magic toward a creature that you can see. It automatically hits and deals 1d4+1 force damage. For each additional action you use when Casting the Spell, increase the number of shards you shoot by one, to a maximum of three shards for 3 actions. You choose the target for each shard individually. If you shoot more than one shard at the same target, combine the damage before applying bonuses or penalties to damage, resistances, weaknesses, and so forth.

Heightened (+2) You fire one additional shard with each action you spend.

spell->Guidance.name: Guidance
spell->Guidance.description:
You ask for the guidance of supernatural entities, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}

spell->Phantom Pain.name: Phantom Pain
spell->Phantom Pain.description:
Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

spell->Shield.name: Shield
spell->Shield.description:
You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

spell->Soothe.name: Soothe
spell->Soothe.description:
You grace the target's mind, boosting its mental defenses and healing its wounds. The target regains 1d10+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell and gains a +2 status bonus to saves against mental effects for the duration.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.nkk4O5fyzrC0057i]{Spell Effect: Soothe}

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d10+4.

spell->Soothe.name: Soothe
spell->Soothe.description:
You grace the target's mind, boosting its mental defenses and healing its wounds. The target regains 1d10+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell and gains a +2 status bonus to saves against mental effects for the duration.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.nkk4O5fyzrC0057i]{Spell Effect: Soothe}

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d10+4.

spell->Soothe.name: Soothe
spell->Soothe.description:
You grace the target's mind, boosting its mental defenses and healing its wounds. The target regains 1d10+4 Hit Points when you Cast the Spell and gains a +2 status bonus to saves against mental effects for the duration.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.nkk4O5fyzrC0057i]{Spell Effect: Soothe}

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing increases by 1d10+4.

action->Twin Bond.name: Twin Bond
action->Twin Bond.description: Daehalyan can communicate telepathically with Kajasiel as long as they are within 100 feet of each other.

action->Burden of Guilt.name: Burden of Guilt
action->Burden of Guilt.description:
Trigger Kajasiel is affected by an emotion effect after attempting a saving throw

Requirements Daehalyan is within 100 feet of Kajasiel

Effect As the current monarch, Daehalyan takes on the emotional burden of the brothers' shared history. He attempts the saving throw, using the same roll as Kajasiel, but with his Will save modifier. He is affected by the emotion effect instead of Kajasiel based on his results.

action->Sovereign Aura.name: Sovereign Aura
action->Sovereign Aura.description: 15 feet. Daehalyan's presence bolsters his followers. Allies in his aura gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls, AC, and saving throws, and at the start of their turn gain 10 temporary Hit Points that last until the start of their next turn.

action->Spare Sibling.name: Spare Sibling
action->Spare Sibling.description: Daehalyan's bond with Kajasiel is such that he can avoid magically harming his twin. If his next action is to Cast a Spell that doesn't have a duration and Kajasiel would be in the spell's area, the spell doesn't target Kajasiel.

spell->Seal Fate.name: Seal Fate
spell->Seal Fate.description:
You utter a curse that a creature will meet a certain end—a death by freezing, stabbing, or another means you devise. Choose one type of damage from the following list: acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, piercing, slashing, sonic, or void. The effect is based on the target's Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target gains weakness 2 to the chosen damage type until the end of your next turn.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute. If the creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points by the chosen damage and its level is 7 or less, it dies.

Critical Failure As failure, but the duration is unlimited.

Heightened (+2) The weakness increases by 1, and the maximum level of creature that can be automatically killed increases by 4.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.r4XX7yzeEOPK7l2a]{Spell Effect: Seal Fate}

spell->Vision of Death.name: Vision of Death
spell->Vision of Death.description:
You force the target to see a vision of its own death. It takes 8d6 mental damage with a Will save. If the target is reduced to 0 HP by this spell, its vision becomes reality and kills it instantly.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as it's frightened.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

spell->Reaper's Lantern.name: Reaper's Lantern
spell->Reaper's Lantern.description:
You call forth a ghostly lantern that guides the living toward death and the undead toward true death. It sheds bright light in the spell's area and dim light to twice that area. The lantern is insubstantial and floats near you, suspended from an ephemeral, skeletal hand. Living creatures and undead in the area when you Cast the Spell, or that enter the area later, must attempt Fortitude saves. Living creatures that fail their Fortitude saves gain only half the normal benefit from healing effects while within the area. Undead targets that fail their Fortitude saves become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} while within the area. Once a creature attempts a save against reaper's lantern, it uses the same outcome if it leaves the area and enters it again.

Once per turn, starting on the round after you cast reaper's lantern, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 5 feet. When you do so, you force creatures in the area that haven't yet attempted a save against reaper's lantern to attempt one.

spell->Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
spell->Detect Magic.description:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

spell->Harm.name: Harm
spell->Harm.description:
You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse void energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
spell->Harm.target: 1 living creature or 1 willing undead creature

spell->Mindlink.name: Mindlink
spell->Mindlink.description: You link your mind to the target's mind and mentally impart to that target an amount of information in an instant that could otherwise be communicated in 10 minutes.

spell->Share Lore.name: Share Lore
spell->Share Lore.description:
You share your knowledge with the touched creatures. Choose one Lore skill in which you're trained. The targets become trained in that Lore skill for the duration of the spell.

Heightened (3rd) The duration of the spell is 1 hour, and you can target up to five creatures.

Heightened (5th) The duration of the spell is 8 hours, you can target up to five creatures, and you can share up to two Lore skills in which you're trained.

spell->Telekinetic Projectile.name: Telekinetic Projectile
spell->Telekinetic Projectile.description:
You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

action->Gestalt.name: Gestalt
action->Gestalt.description: Death grants the following additional spells to any gestalt he joins: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZMvplR106Jxl7B15]{Awaken Entropy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8THDHP0UC7SgOYYF]{Inevitable Disaster}.

action->Hasten the End.name: Hasten the End
action->Hasten the End.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A creature within 30 feet is about to attempt a basic saving throw against a spell or effect with the death trait

Effect If the target gets a success or critical success on the triggering save, it instead gets an outcome one degree of success worse than the result of the roll.

armor->Leather Apron.name: Leather Apron
armor->Leather Apron.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

action->Grave Weapon.name: Grave Weapon
action->Grave Weapon.description: The wight is bound to a dagger it was buried with. Other wights can be bound to different weapons.

action->Final Spite.name: Final Spite
action->Final Spite.description:
Trigger The wight is reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect The wight makes a Strike before being destroyed. This Strike can inflict corrupting spite, but fueled by spite doesn't apply.

action->Fueled by Spite.name: Fueled by Spite
action->Fueled by Spite.description: Each time a creature loses Hit Points due to a corrupting spite curse the wight inflicted, the wight gains 3 temporary Hit Points.

action->Corrupting Spite.name: Corrupting Spite
action->Corrupting Spite.description:
The wight's unarmed attacks and bound weapons inflict a curse that makes a creature grow weak and spiteful. If a wight inflicts corrupting spite on a creature already afflicted by it, the victim attempts a new save, ignoring the result if it's better than a failure.

A living humanoid that dies while under the curse rises as a wight after [[/gmr 1d4 #Wight Spawn Timer]]{1d4 rounds}, controlled by the wight that killed it. The wight spawn can't inflict corrupting spite and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}. If its creator dies or after roughly a month of existence, the new wight becomes autonomous and turns into a normal wight

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:17|options:inflicts:drained];

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and doesn't treat any creatures as allies (1 round)

Stage 3 As stage 2, except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} (1 round)

Stage 4 As stage 2, except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 4} (1 round).

Devouring Serpents.name: Devouring Serpents
Devouring Serpents.description: Spectral serpents emerge from the ground to devour living creatures.
Devouring Serpents.disable: @Check[occultism|dc:38] (expert) or Religion (expert) to placate Yig, or @Check[athletics|dc:41] (master) to force the serpents' jaws closed; three successes total to disable the haunt
Devouring Serpents.routine: The haunt makes a jaws Strike against each creature in the chamber as its first action. As its second action, it forces each creature hit by its jaws Strike to attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:34|options:inflicts:grabbed,inflicts:restrained] save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} until it [[/act escape dc=36]]{Escapes}. On a critical failure, or if the creature was already grabbed by the haunt, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} instead.

action->Spectral Snakebites.name: Spectral Snakebites
action->Spectral Snakebites.description:
Trigger A creature touches Jazali's religious symbol.

Effect Puncture wounds appear across the flesh of the triggering creature, who must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:39|options:damaging-effect,inflicts:persistent-damage] save. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(3d12+17)[piercing]] damage.

Failure As failure, except the creature also takes @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]] damage as their blood fails to clot.

Critical Failure As failure, except the persistent bleed damage is 4d6.

action->Three-Headed.name: Three-Headed
action->Three-Headed.description: Any ability that would sever a greater chimera's head (such as a critical hit with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.6xaxxKfvXED6LfIY]{Vorpal} weapon) severs one head at random. Losing a head doesn't kill a chimera (as long as it has at least one head left), but it does prevent it from making Strikes with the lost head or using any abilities granted by the head.

action->Fire Breath.name: Fire Breath
action->Fire Breath.description: Doomcrier's magma worm head exhales a blast of flame in a @Template[type:cone|distance:30] that deals @Damage[16d6[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures in the area (@Check[reflex|dc:36|basic|options:area-effect] save). It can't use Fire Breath again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Fire Breath]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Multiple Reactions.name: Multiple Reactions
action->Multiple Reactions.description: A greater chimera gains 2 extra reactions each round that it can use only to make Reactive Strikes. It must use a different head for each reaction, and it can't use more than one on the same triggering action. If it loses one of its heads, it also loses one of these extra reactions.

action->Storm Blast.name: Storm Blast
action->Storm Blast.description: Doomcrier's thunderbird head blasts its foes with peals of thunder and crackling bolts of lightning. Each creature in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] takes @Damage[8d6[electricity],8d6[sonic]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:36|basic] save). Doomcrier can't use Lightning Blast for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Three-Headed Strike.name: Three-Headed Strike
action->Three-Headed Strike.description: The greater chimera makes a Strike with each of its heads, each at a –2 penalty and targeting a different creature. These Strikes count as only one attack for the greater chimera's multiple attack penalty, and the penalty doesn't increase until after it has made all three attacks.

action->Vision of Doom.name: Vision of Doom
action->Vision of Doom.description:
A creature hit by Doomcrier's black dog jaws Strike sees visions of their own doom. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:36|options:inflicts:doomed,inflicts:frightened] save. If Doomcrier critically hits, the creature also becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} for as long as they are frightened by vision of doom.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and immune to vision of doom for 24 hours.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4}.

Dragonfire Fly.name: Dragonfire Fly
Dragonfire Fly.publicNotes:
A dragonfire fly is an immense dragonfly with wings veined in delicate traceries of red fire. Its faceted eyes are huge gemstones that blaze with internal luminescence. While on the hunt, the dragonfire fly zips through subterranean labyrinths or clings silently to cavern walls, lancing prey with solid jets of flame cast from its eyes.

Although dragonfire flies most often use fire to catch their food, they adapt readily to their enemies' weapons and defenses. When magic harms a dragonfire fly, the fly's eyes and the flames across its wings change color, burning with white frost, yellow electricity, or whatever other energy it was exposed to. This same energy burns in the dragonfire fly's eye rays.

Opal Eyes

If a dragonfire fly’s eyes resemble gems, it’s because they are! Both of a dragonfire fly’s multifaceted eyes are immense, translucent opals as large as a human head. The gems change hue when the fly’s flame takes on a new color, and they retain this color when the dragonfire fly dies. Each of the fly’s eyes is worth at least 10,000 gold—if a buyer for such a large single stone can be found.

action->Barrel Roll.name: Barrel Roll
action->Barrel Roll.description:
Trigger While Flying, the dragonfire fly is hit by a ranged Strike that deals physical damage

Effect The fly spins in flight, deflecting some of the force of the attack. The fly gains resistance 15 to physical damage from the triggering attack.

action->Fire Wings.name: Fire Wings
action->Fire Wings.description:
When the fly is first encountered, the fly's wings burn with red flame. When the fly takes acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, or void damage, the fly's wing flame color changes depending on the type of damage dealt. If an attack or effect deals more than one of these damage types, the fly chooses which damage type affects their fire wings color. The fly gains resistance 15 to the damage type associated with its new fire wings color, and its eye beam ranged Strike deals that damage type. After 1 minute, the fly's fire wings revert to red flame. The damage type, fire color, and other effects of each fire wings color are:

Acid: Green fire. A creature that starts their turn in the fly's firelight aura takes @Damage[3d6[persistent,acid]] damage.

Cold: White fire. A creature that starts their turn in the fly's firelight aura takes a –15-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

Electricity: Yellow fire. A creature that starts their turn in the fly's firelight aura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Fire: Red fire. A creature that starts their turn in the fly's firelight aura takes @Damage[6d6[fire]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:32|basic] save.

Sonic: Purple fire. The fly emits a loud buzz. A creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} while in the fly's firelight aura.

Void: Black fire. The fly becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and loses its firelight aura until its Fire Wings change to a different color.

action->Firelight.name: Firelight
action->Firelight.description: 30 feet. The aura sheds dim light of the same color as the fly's current fire wings color.

action->Carry.name: Carry
action->Carry.description: The fly can Fly at half Speed while it has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} in its mandibles, carrying that creature along with it.

Dream Cradle of the Dark Tapestry.name: Dream Cradle of the Dark Tapestry
Dream Cradle of the Dark Tapestry.description: Long ago, Yig revealed that some of his sekmin children slept deep beneath the Kodar Mountains. In response, his surface-dwelling worshippers developed this item to navigate the Darklands' vast chasms in search of the Great Old One's lost progeny. When the dream cradle of the Dark Tapestry is activated as a single action with the concentrate trait, over the course of 1 minute, the fist-sized egg expands to the size of a hot-air balloon, to which a basket or other platform can be attached.
Dream Cradle of the Dark Tapestry.pilotingCheck: Arcana (DC 30), Religion (DC 32), Occultism (DC 30), or Piloting Lore (DC 29)

action->Burst.name: Burst
action->Burst.description: When the dream cradle is destroyed, the egg-balloon shatters, releasing a cloud of nightmarish oneiric energy. Creatures other than the pilot and passengers within 30 feet of the dream cradle take @Damage[14d6[mental]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[will|dc:32|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:fleeing,inflicts:frightened] save). On a failed save, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round on a critical failure). The dream cradle then uses that last of its magical reserves to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.A2JfEKe6BZcTG1S8]{Fly} on the pilot and each passenger.

action->Recharge.name: Recharge
action->Recharge.description: Each day, the dream cradle can be used for up to 1 hour before it shrinks back into its egg form to recharge for 8 hours. One minute before it shrinks, the balloon wobbles in warning, giving the pilot time to land.

action->Vertical Travel.name: Vertical Travel
action->Vertical Travel.description: The dream cradle's Speed doubles while moving straight up or down

spell->Blessed Boundary.name: Blessed Boundary
spell->Blessed Boundary.description:
Manifestations of divine force appear in the hundreds, swirling in a massive, protective sphere. These typically look like spiky fragments, but often take on an appearance themed to the deity of the caster. The sphere is hollow, with the manifestations forming a shell 2 inches deep on the outer edge. You can choose to make the burst smaller, in 5-foot increments, when you cast it. The shell provides cover and can intersect solid terrain without affecting it. The shell deals 7d8 force damage to each creature who intersects with the shell when the sphere's created, or who attempts to move through the shell. The creature also takes the damage at the end of its turn, but only if it didn't already take damage from the shell that turn. The effects are determined by a creature's Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage, is pushed up to 10 feet in the direction of your choice, and ends its movement.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is pushed up to 20 feet in the direction of your choice, and ends its movement.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

spell->Sacred Form.name: Sacred Form
spell->Sacred Form.description:
You focus all your divine energy and transform yourself into a battle form, similar to your normal form and of the same size as you, but wielding powerful divine armaments. While in this form, you gain the statistics and abilities listed below. You have hands in this battle form and can use manipulate actions. You can Dismiss the spell. You gain the following statistics and abilities.

  • AC = 20 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 10 temporary Hit Points.
  • Speed 40 feet.
  • Resistance 3 against physical damage.
  • Darkvision.
  • A special attack with a sacred armament, which is the only attack you can use. Your attack modifier with the sacred armament is +21, and your damage bonus is +8 (or +6 for a ranged attack). The damage dice for Strikes with the weapon are 3d6 bludgeoning damage plus 1d6 spirit damage. If you have a deity, you can have the weapon take the form of your deity's favored weapon and use its damage die size, damage type, and traits. If the favored weapon is a simple weapon with 1d4 or 1d6 damage die, the weapon damage dice are one size larger than normal, though the spirit damage is unchanged. You can also use your attack modifier with this favored weapon if it's higher than that given by the spell.
  • Athletics modifier of +23, unless your own is higher.

Heightened (8th) You instead gain AC = 21 + your level, 15 temporary Hit Points, resistance 4 against physical damage, attack modifier +28, damage bonus +15 (+12 for a ranged attack), and Athletics +29. If you're Medium or smaller, your battle form is Large, and your attacks also have 10-foot reach, or 15-foot reach if you're using a favored weapon with reach.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.W4lb3417rNDd9tCq]{Spell Effect: Sacred Form}

spell->Scintillating Safeguard.name: Scintillating Safeguard
spell->Scintillating Safeguard.description:
Trigger An effect would deal physical or energy damage to you or a creature in range.

A sparkling magical barrier envelops each target, shielding them against the triggering effect. Choose one type of physical or energy damage the triggering effect deals. Each target gains resistance 10 against that damage type for the triggering effect. The resistance applies only against the initial damage, not against any persistent damage or other lingering effects.

Heightened (+1) The resistance increases by 1.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.XstFvzPDKCfmoIED]{Spell Effect: Scintillating Safeguard}
spell->Scintillating Safeguard.target: up to 5 willing creatures who would be harmed by the triggering effect

spell->Truesight (Constant).name: Truesight (Constant)
spell->Truesight (Constant).description: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

spell->Banishment.name: Banishment
spell->Banishment.description:
You send the target back to its home plane. The target must attempt a Will save. You can spend an extra action while Casting this Spell and add a cost to the spell to give the creature a –2 circumstance penalty to its save. The cost must be a specially gathered object that is anathema to the creature. This spell fails if you aren't on your home plane when you cast it.

Critical Success The target resists being banished and you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Success The target resists being banished.

Failure The target is banished.

Critical Failure The target is banished and can't return by any means to the plane it's banished from for 1 week.

Heightened (9th) You can target up to 10 creatures. The extra cost affects targets to which it is anathema.
spell->Banishment.target: 1 creature that isn't on its home plane

spell->Invoke Spirits.name: Invoke Spirits
spell->Invoke Spirits.description:
Ragged apparitions of the dead rise to stalk the living. They deal 2d4 mental damage and 2d4 void damage to each living creature in the area, with a basic Will save. Additionally, creatures that critically fail the save are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

On subsequent rounds, the first time you Sustain the Spell each round, you can move the area up to 30 feet within the range of the spell. Living creatures in the new area must attempt saves with the same effects as above, except that critically failing doesn't make them flee.

Heightened (+2) The mental damage and void damage each increase by 1d4.

spell->Truespeech (Constant).name: Truespeech (Constant)
spell->Truespeech (Constant).description:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

spell->Ghostly Tragedy.name: Ghostly Tragedy
spell->Ghostly Tragedy.description:
This spell compels local spirits to reenact a violent event of the recent past that you're aware of and name as you Cast the Spell. You take the role of the primary victim. The reenactment plays out the final 9 minutes leading up to the death or injury of the victim and the minute after. The spirits don't change form, so this doesn't help determine perpetrators by their looks. Spiritual forms of missing creatures necessary for the event manifest as needed, and missing items appear as shadowy outlines.

Once the scene ends, you take @Damage[2d6[void]] damage for each ghostly apparition that participated in the scene (typically equal to the number of creatures involved other than the victim). Any creature that observed the ghostly recreation, including you, can attempt checks to investigate the event to discover new clues and information.

spell->Read Omens.name: Read Omens
spell->Read Omens.description: You peek into the future. Choose a particular goal or activity you plan to engage in within 1 week, or an event you expect might happen within 1 week. You learn a cryptic clue or piece of advice that could help with the chosen event, often in the form of a rhyme or omen.

spell->Unfettered Movement.name: Unfettered Movement
spell->Unfettered Movement.description:
You repel effects that would hinder a creature or slow its movement. While under this spell's effect, the target ignores effects that would give them a circumstance penalty to Speed. When they attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} an effect that has them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, they automatically succeed unless the effect is magical and of a higher rank than the unfettered movement spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.CdAyAiMGESvgNQtz]{Spell Effect: Unfettered Movement}

spell->Whispers of the Void.name: Whispers of the Void
spell->Whispers of the Void.description:
You whisper baleful secrets that transcend language and carry magically to the ears of your foes. The words take physical form, weakening the life force of the targets, each of which must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2))d8[persistent,void]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(floor(@item.rank/2)*2)d8[persistent,void]] damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}.

Heightened (+2) The persistent void damage increases by 1d8 on a success, or by 2d8 on a failure or critical failure.

spell->Blindness.name: Blindness
spell->Blindness.description:
You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

spell->Chilling Darkness.name: Chilling Darkness
spell->Chilling Darkness.description:
You shoot an utterly cold ray of darkness tinged with unholy energy. Make a ranged spell attack. The ray deals 5d6 cold damage. If the target has the holy trait, you deal an extra 5d6 spirit damage.

Critical Success The target takes double damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

If the ray passes through an area of magical light or targets a creature affected by magical light, chilling darkness attempts to counteract the light. If you need to determine whether the ray passes through an area of light, draw a line between yourself and the spell's target.

Heightened (+1) The cold damage increases by 2d6, and the spirit damage against holy creatures increases by 2d6.

spell->Rouse Skeletons.name: Rouse Skeletons
spell->Rouse Skeletons.description:
Misshapen skeletal forms erupt from a solid surface, such as a stone floor, and fill the burst. The area they fill is difficult terrain. Their grasping claws deal 2d6 slashing damage to creatures on the ground in the area when the skeletons first appear with a basic Reflex save.

On subsequent rounds, the first time you Sustain the Spell each round, you can move the area of skeletons up to 20 feet within the range of the spell and deal 2d6 slashing damage with a basic Reflex save to each creature in the new area.

Damaging or destroying the skeletons is irrelevant, as new bones pull forth from the ground to repair and replace any that are obliterated.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

spell->Calm.name: Calm
spell->Calm.description:
You forcibly calm creatures in the area, soothing them into a nonviolent state; each creature must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success Calming urges impose a -1 status penalty to the creature's attack rolls.

Failure Any emotion effects that would affect the creature are suppressed and the creature can't use hostile actions. If the target is subject to hostility from any other creature, it ceases to be affected by calm.

Critical Failure As failure, but hostility doesn't end the effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Qr5rgoZvI4KmFY0N]{Spell Effect: Calm}

spell->Resist Energy.name: Resist Energy
spell->Resist Energy.description:
A shield of elemental energy protects a creature against one type of energy damage. Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. The target and its gear gain resistance 5 against the damage type you chose.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{Spell Effect: Resist Energy}

Heightened (4th) The resistance increases to 10, and you can target up to two creatures.

Heightened (7th) The resistance increases to 15, and you can target up to five creatures.

spell->Silence.name: Silence
spell->Silence.description:
The target makes no sound, preventing creatures from noticing it using hearing alone. The target can't use sonic attacks, nor can it use actions with the auditory trait. This prevents it from casting spells due to the magical words involved in casting, with the exception of subtle spells.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.mmJNE57hC7G3SPae]{Spell Effect: Silence}

Heightened (4th) The spell creates an aura in a 10-foot emanation around the touched creature, silencing all sound in or passing through it. While within the aura, creatures are subject to the same effects as the target. Depending upon the position of the effect, a creature might notice the lack of sound reaching it (blocking off the noise coming from a party, for example).

spell->Bane.name: Bane
spell->Bane.description:
You fill the minds of your enemies with doubt. Enemies in the area must succeed at a Will save or take a –1 status penalty to attack rolls as long as they are in the area. Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to increase the emanation's radius by 10 feet and force enemies in the area that weren't yet affected to attempt another saving throw.

Bane can counteract @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XSujb7EsSwKl19Uu]{Bless}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.UTLp7omqsiC36bso]{Spell Effect: Bane}

spell->Command.name: Command
spell->Command.description:
You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
spell->Detect Magic.description:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

spell->Fear.name: Fear
spell->Fear.description:
You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

spell->Read Aura.name: Read Aura
spell->Read Aura.description:
You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.J6OhRNSN23KzOPRL]{Spell Effect: Read Aura}

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

spell->Void Warp.name: Void Warp
spell->Void Warp.description:
You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

action->Rejuvenation.name: Rejuvenation
action->Rejuvenation.description: Phreygia's echo persists until Yig wills her out of existence. Even if destroyed, she returns within [[/gmr 1d4 #days]]{1d4 days}, restored completely with full Hit Points and no conditions.

Eroded Vault Lifter.name: Eroded Vault Lifter
Eroded Vault Lifter.publicNotes:
Vault lifters are sentient stone constructs roughly carved into the semblance of giant xiomorns. Each vault lifter is encircled by a spinning ring, called a rotor, which grants the lifter the ability to fly.

Xiomorns created vault lifters to help construct their vaults throughout the Plane of Earth and across the Universe. With the ability to airlift heavy burdens and possessed with enough intelligence to carry out complex instructions, vault lifters were valuable lieutenants in the xiomorns' vast terraforming projects. Vault lifters were intended to be more than simple laborers, however; they were also built as weapons of war. In combat, vault lifters spin their rotors into fearsome buzz saws capable of propelling them at high speeds and slicing foes in half.

Abandoned Guardians

While some vault lifters continue to serve living xiomorns, others have been left behind in long-abandoned locations. Over the years, many of these forgotten vault lifters have completed their assignments and deactivated themselves. Others continue to perform some unending task, such as "keep this area clean," "prevent unauthorized entry," or "I'll be back in a bit—wait for my return." After millennia spent in solitude, some abandoned vault lifters become fanatical about their final orders, spinning them into complex philosophical systems heavy with moral significance.

action->Overgrown.name: Overgrown
action->Overgrown.description: These vault lifters have been partially reclaimed by the elements. At the start of an encounter, the lifter is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} until the end of its first turn.

action->Activate Rotor.name: Activate Rotor
action->Activate Rotor.description:
The vault lifter's rotor spins, becoming a buzzing blur. While the rotor is activated, the lifter gains a fly Speed of 40 feet. The spinning rotor also creates an aura in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] around the lifter. Any creature that enters or starts its turn in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:34|options:damaging-effect,forced-movement,inflicts:prone] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected, and the vault lifter's rotor is deactivated. The lifter loses its fly Speed and aura until it Activates Rotor again.

Success The creature takes @Damage[2d8[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[4d8[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[8d8[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage. If the creature isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by the vault lifter, they are pushed back 15 feet and knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

action->Carry.name: Carry
action->Carry.description: A vault lifter can Fly at half Speed while it has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, carrying that creature along with it.

action->Draw In.name: Draw In
action->Draw In.description: The vault lifter attempts to [[/act reposition]] a creature it has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, moving the creature into a space adjacent to it. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the lifter's multiple attack penalty.

action->Overdrive.name: Overdrive
action->Overdrive.description:
Requirements The vault lifter's rotor is activated

Effect The lifter Flies up to three times its Fly Speed in a straight line without triggering reactions. At the end of this flight, the lifter must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:40] saving throw. On a failure, the lifter's rotor is deactivated.

Etumult.name: Etumult
Etumult.publicNotes:
In ancient times, a cabal of primalists imbued an amalgam of beasts with both supernatural might and a hatred of magic itself, hoping to achieve a potent weapon for use against arcane spellcasters. Effective beyond expectation, the first leydroths broke free and turned on their creators. Worse, the leydroths bred true, and these reclusive predators have long outlived their original creators.

Leydroths look like distorted, apelike felines with many-branching horns growing from the backs of their heads. Their thickly muscled limbs end in glowing claws.
Etumult.saveDetails: +2 status to all saves vs. magic

spell->Detonate Magic.name: Detonate Magic
spell->Detonate Magic.description: You cause the magic within the target to dissipate in a destructive explosion. You attempt to counteract the target. If the attempt succeeds, an explosion of magical force deals 8d6 force damage with a basic Reflex save. If you successfully counteract the magic of an item, it's deactivated for 1 week (or destroyed on a critical success) and the explosion is a 5-foot emanation from the item. If you successfully counteract a spell, the effect ends and the explosion affects either all creatures in the spell's area or the target of the spell and all creatures in a 5-foot emanation around it.

spell->Dispel Magic (At Will).name: Dispel Magic (At Will)
spell->Dispel Magic (At Will).description: You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.
spell->Dispel Magic (At Will).target: 1 spell effect or unattended magic item

action->Magic Sense.name: Magic Sense
action->Magic Sense.description: The leydroth detects the source and school of each source of magic within 60 feet as an imprecise sense.

action->+2 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

action->Menace to Magic.name: Menace to Magic
action->Menace to Magic.description:
Trigger A creature within 60 feet Casts a Spell

Effect The leydroth attempts an @Check[intimidation] check to counteract the triggering spell.

action->Dispelling Roar.name: Dispelling Roar
action->Dispelling Roar.description:
The leydroth unleashes a bestial roar that reverberates within a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. It rolls an Intimidation check and compares the result to the Will DC of each creature in the area, with the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}.

It also uses this result to attempt to counteract each spell or magical effect in the area, plus one item or effect on each creature in the area, with the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic}.

The leydroth can't use Dispelling Roar again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Dispelling Roar]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Dispelling Strike.name: Dispelling Strike
action->Dispelling Strike.description:
Frequency once per round

Trigger The leydroth hits a creature, object, or spell effect with a Strike

Effect The leydroth casts its innate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic}, targeting one effect on the creature struck.

action->Spell Feedback.name: Spell Feedback
action->Spell Feedback.description: Any time a leydroth counteracts a spell or item, the spell's caster or the creature holding the item takes @Damage[8d6[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:38|basic] save).

Facetal Branch.name: Facetal Branch
Facetal Branch.publicNotes:
Facetal branches are elder facetals whose gemstone bodies have grown into large glowing crystals. Instead of donning humanoid guises as facetal nodes do, facetal branches use hardlight to project insect-like bodies in the image of their deity, Sairazul.

With minds capable of revisiting their memories with crystalline perfection, facetal branches can both move and communicate across space and time. They're named after the constant improvements they make to their past selves, navigating branches of alternate histories to achieve crystalline perfection.

Gathering Moss

While their younger cousins, facetal nodes, travel to accumulate knowledge, facetal branches turn their explorations inwards, scrutinizing past actions for minor imperfections that could stunt their slow, crystalline growth. When they identify a flaw, they can reach backwards in time to alter their past—but only if their past self occupies the same location as their present one. For this reason, facetal branches tend to stay put.

action->Temporal Telepathy.name: Temporal Telepathy
action->Temporal Telepathy.description: The facetal branch can communicate telepathically with themselves at a specific moment in the past, provided their past self occupies the branch's current space.

action->Gem Form.name: Gem Form
action->Gem Form.description:
When a facetal node is reduced to 0 Hit Points, their hardlight body is destroyed, leaving behind the node's true form, a Tiny glowing gemstone. In this form, the node's Speed is 0, they're immune to damage, and they're deactivated. While deactivated, they can't take actions or speak, although they can use telepathy. The node remains deactivated until it reactivates at a time determined by the GM (usually after decades or more).

While deactivated, the facetal branch can't use temporal telepathy, and their luminescent aura is deactivated.

action->Luminescent Aura.name: Luminescent Aura
action->Luminescent Aura.description: 30 feet. The facetal branch's glowing gem fills the area of the aura with bright light. The branch can deactivate or activate its aura as a single action with the concentrate trait.

action->Blinding Attack.name: Blinding Attack
action->Blinding Attack.description: On a critical hit with a gem ray Strike, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

action->Blinking Strobe.name: Blinking Strobe
action->Blinking Strobe.description:
The node's gem coruscates with light. Enemies within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:40|options:area-effect,inflicts:dazzled,inflicts:blinded] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target is teleported to a space of the node's choice within 30 feet that the node can see.

action->Hardlight Projection.name: Hardlight Projection
action->Hardlight Projection.description: The node projects a new Huge, insect-like form around itself, changing its appearance but not its statistics. The node's projected form is a solid body made of hardlight. While using a projected form, the node's true form, a Tiny gem, is always visible embedded in the projection's abdomen or thorax. The gemstone is the facetal's sensory organ, and if the gemstone is covered, the facetal node is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}.

action->Temporal Skip.name: Temporal Skip
action->Temporal Skip.description:
The facetal branch can pluck creatures from the very flow of time. One creature the branch can see within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:40] save. The branch can target themself, automatically failing their save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to Temporal Skip for 24 hours.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The creature winks out of existence for 1 round (or for up to 1 hour if the branch targeted themself). Until the creature reappears, time doesn't pass for the creature. When the effect ends, the creature returns to the space it occupied when it disappeared or to the nearest space if the original is now filled.

Facetal Node.name: Facetal Node
Facetal Node.publicNotes:
Facetal nodes are the youngest facetals, having lived for mere tens of thousands of years. Though nearly eternal from the viewpoint of mortals, nodes measure their lives on a geological time scale, regarding themselves as neophytes compared to elder facetals and other immortal elementals. Most facetal nodes travel far and wide to gather knowledge, using their projected humanoid bodies to blend in among other sentient beings. They tend to observe the affairs of mortals impassively, unmoved by hardships which, from their perspective, last no longer than the blink of an eye.

Formed under immense geological pressure over untold eons, facetals are intelligent, eloquent elemental gemstones. While facetals can’t affect the world in their true gem forms, they can focus their inner radiance to create corporeal bodies made of hardlight.

Everpresent Gem

No matter what form they project to the world, a facetal node's true body—their gem—is always visible somewhere on their hardlight body. Since a facetal node senses the world through this gemstone, they often go to great pains to hide the stone's significance, disguising it as an ordinary piece of jewelry, the crystal on the tip of a walking staff, or some other mundane jewel. A facetal's gem is functionally unbreakable, requiring the will of a god or similar force to shatter it.

action->Gem Form.name: Gem Form
action->Gem Form.description: When a facetal node is reduced to 0 Hit Points, their hardlight body is destroyed, leaving behind the node's true form, a Tiny glowing gemstone. In this form, the node's Speed is 0, they're immune to damage, and they're deactivated. While deactivated, they can't take actions or speak, although they can use telepathy. The node remains deactivated until it reactivates at a time determined by the GM (usually after decades or more).

action->Blinding Attack.name: Blinding Attack
action->Blinding Attack.description: On a critical hit with a gem ray Strike, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

action->Blinking Strobe.name: Blinking Strobe
action->Blinking Strobe.description:
The node's gem coruscates with light. Enemies within a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30] must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:37|options:area-effect,inflicts:dazzled,inflicts:blinded] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target is teleported to a space of the node's choice within 30 feet that the node can see.

action->Hardlight Projection.name: Hardlight Projection
action->Hardlight Projection.description: The node projects a new Small or Medium humanoid form around itself, changing its appearance but not its statistics. The node's projected form is a solid body made of hardlight. While using a projected form, the node's true form, a Tiny gem, is always visible somewhere on the projection, such as set into a piece of jewelry. The gemstone is the facetal's sensory organ, and if the gemstone is covered, the facetal node is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}.

False Prayer.name: False Prayer
False Prayer.description: A statue dedicated to Ydersius fills the chamber with the divine glory of the Father of Serpents.
False Prayer.disable: @Check[deception|dc:43] (master) to falsely proclaim the party's devotion to Ydersius, @Check[religion|dc:41] (master) to rededicate the statue to Yig, or @Check[thievery|dc:38] (expert) twice to pry the statue's eyes from their sockets
False Prayer.reset: Unless the statue is destroyed, both its eyes are removed, or the statue is rededicated to Yig, the hazard deactivates and resets 1 minute after no living creatures are in the room.
False Prayer.routine: (2 actions) The statue uses each of its two actions to cast a 9th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZxHC7V7HtjUsB8zH]{Blazing Bolt} spell (DC 41), targeting up to three living creatures per casting. For each eye removed from the statue, the hazard has 1 fewer action. Until the beginning of the statue's next turn, the doors to area H17 don't require an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open} (but opening them still requires an Interact action).

action->Divine Command.name: Divine Command
action->Divine Command.description:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the doors to area H17 or attempts to disable the hazard and fails

Effect The light from the statue's eyes intensifies. The statue casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.fkDeKktdmbeplYRY]{Overwhelming Presence} (@Check[will|dc:41|options:area-effect,item:type:spell|traits:auditory,concentrate,incapacitation,manipulate,mental,visual]), targeting each living creature in the room. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Fate of Eivess.name: Fate of Eivess
Fate of Eivess.description: The restless spirits of the prophet Eivess and his followers force intruders to relive their deaths at the fangs of Yig's avatar.
Fate of Eivess.disable: @Check[society|dc:38] (master) or @Check[religion|dc:40] (master) to convince the spirits that their horror has been over for millennia, or @Check[occultism|dc:38] (master) or @Check[intimidation|dc:42] to recognize that this avatar exists only in the memories of the tormented spirits and command it to stand down; three total successes are required to disable the haunt
Fate of Eivess.routine: (3 actions) The avatar uses its first action each round to Devour Faithful, then attempts to Strike and swallow a frightened creature within 20 feet. If no nearby creatures are frightened, the avatar continues using its actions to Devour Faithful until a frightened victim becomes available.

action->Massacre.name: Massacre
action->Massacre.description:
Trigger Eivess places the last of the eggs on the ground and calls for Yig to appear

Effect The towering serpent rises over the hill and snatches Eivess in its jaws, swallowing him whole and sparking mass panic among his followers, with the effects of Devour Faithful. The haunt rolls initiative.

action->Devour Faithful.name: Devour Faithful
action->Devour Faithful.description: The avatar of Yig seizes a nearby follower and gulps them down. The terrifying sight deals @Damage[(3d10+15)[mental]|options:area-damage] damage to all creatures within 30 feet (@Check[will|dc:30|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened] save). Any creature that takes this mental damage is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure.

action->Swallow Whole.name: Swallow Whole
action->Swallow Whole.description:
Huge, @Damage[(3d10+15)[mental]], Rupture 40

A swallowed creature hurtles through a terrifying vortex of indistinct shadows, surrounded by the distant wails of swallowed pilgrims. They can't reduce their @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} value below 1 until they [[/act escape]] or cut themselves free.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.SwallowWhole]

Fleshwarp Fetters.name: Fleshwarp Fetters
Fleshwarp Fetters.description: A surge of fleshwarping magic twists creatures' limbs, especially those used to move.
Fleshwarp Fetters.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:30] (trained) or @Check[occultism|dc:30] (expert) to disrupt the magic, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (6th rank, DC 28) to counteract the fleshwarping

action->Hobble.name: Hobble
action->Hobble.description:
Trigger A creature enters the area marked T on the map

Effect Each creature in the marked area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:32] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to the effects of warpline hazards for 1 hour.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature's limbs twist unnaturally. They take a –5-foot status penalty to their Speeds for 1 day.

Critical Failure The creature takes a –10-foot status penalty to their Speeds for 1 week.

Flinching Fleshwarp.name: Flinching Fleshwarp
Flinching Fleshwarp.description: A surge of fleshwarping magic sets nerves on fire.
Flinching Fleshwarp.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:30] (trained) or Occultism (expert) to disrupt the magic, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (6th rank, DC 28) to counteract the fleshwarping.

action->Jolt.name: Jolt
action->Jolt.description:
Trigger A creature opens a cell door

Effect The triggering creature and each creature within 10 feet of them must attempt a @Check[will|dc:32|options:area-effect,damaging-effect] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes immune to the effects of warpline hazards for 1 hour.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(3d10+14)[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage as their nerves jolt with painful energy. For 1 day, each time the creature takes damage, they must spend at least one action on their next turn to Stride (or to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim, if they have the corresponding movement type). If they don't, they take @Damage[(3d10+14)[electricity]] damage at the end of their turn.

Critical Failure As failure, except the effect lasts 1 week.

Freezing Runes.name: Freezing Runes
Freezing Runes.description: Spirals of cold energy rise from the runes to strike those sneaking food out of the area.
Freezing Runes.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:36] (expert) to deactivate the runes, @Check[thievery|dc:38] (master) to scratch out the runes, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (8th rank; counteract DC 34)
Freezing Runes.reset: Unless disabled or destroyed, the hazard resets automatically after being triggered.

action->Freezing Whirl.name: Freezing Whirl
action->Freezing Whirl.description:
Trigger A living creature attempts to leave area F3 while carrying anything edible, even a consumable such as an elixir or potion

Effect An icy draft rises from the runes and whirls about the triggering creature. The creature takes @Damage[(6d12+35)[cold]] damage, with a @Check[fortitude|dc:37|basic|options:inflicts:slowed] save. On a failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute. On critical failure, the creature is instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified} as they become encased in a layer of ice. A creature petrified in this way can be restored if exposed to a significant heat source (such as a campfire) for 10 minutes.

General Vesperix.name: General Vesperix
General Vesperix.publicNotes:
Xiomorn troopers are an elite military force formed from the ranks of xiomorn vault keepers. Armed with technology only they understand, xiomorn troopers hold the line against those who oppose the mysterious aims of the vault builders.

Many xiomorn troopers possess special training or equipment that helps them perform specific roles within their strike force. Comm troopers, for example, can communicate telepathically with their fellow troopers, while scout troopers surround themselves with fields of light-bending energy on their patrols. The batons of shock troopers carry charges of electricity that they use to stun their foes, while rad troopers are armed with explosives that release bursts of a sickening radiation, to which the troopers themselves are immune.

Mysterious Generals

Some xiomorn troopers consider themselves part of a single military organization led by a figure whose identity is unknown even to the highest-ranking troopers. Referred to only as the "Commander," this mysterious leader hands down orders along an extended, telepathic chain of command. In many Orvian vaults, the Commander is presumed to be a vault builder—or perhaps a fellow trooper in direct contact with the builders—though some troopers insist the Commander is simply an imaginary figurehead created to inspire loyalty. The fact that different squads of troopers have at times been given conflicting orders lends credence to the latter belief.

spell->Heaving Earth.name: Heaving Earth
spell->Heaving Earth.description:
You strike the ground, and unleash a wave that travels through the struck surface to the target. The effect ends as soon as it can't travel through a solid surface, such as a stone floor. Each creature in a line between you and the target is shaken by tremors and must attempt a Reflex saving throw against your spell DC. A creature that fails this save is pushed 10 feet away from you.

The wave explodes once it reaches the target, showering the target with earth and stone and dealing @Damage[12d10[bludgeoning]] damage with a basic Reflex save. A target that fails its save against this explosion is also pushed back 10 feet and knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. A creature subject to the explosion doesn't need to save against the tremors.

Heightened (9th) The wave explodes on one additional target of your choice in the line to the final target.
spell->Heaving Earth.target: 1 creature or object on the ground

spell->Wall of Stone.name: Wall of Stone
spell->Wall of Stone.description:
