You shape a wall of solid stone. You create a 1-inch-thick wall of stone up to 120 feet long, and 20 feet high. You can shape the wall's path, placing each 5 feet of the wall on the border between squares. The wall doesn't need to stand vertically, so you can use it to form a bridge or set of stairs, for example. You must conjure the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 14, and 50 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section of the wall can be moved through, but the rubble created from it is difficult terrain.

Heightened (+2) The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 15.

spell->One with Stone.name: One with Stone
spell->One with Stone.description:
You can either transform into a stone or merge with stone. While transformed, you can't move or affect anything outside the stone, but you can cast spells as long as they don't require line of effect beyond the stone. You can Dismiss this spell.

  • Merge with Stone The spell's duration is 10 minutes. While casting the spell, you must touch a stone with enough volume to fit you and your possessions or the spell is disrupted. While merged, you can hear, but not see, what's going on outside the stone. If the stone takes damage while you're inside it, you're expelled from the stone and take 10d6 damage. Magic passage expels you without dealing damage. The spell ends if you're ever outside the stone.
  • Turn into a Stone The spell's duration is 8 hours. You become a Large stone. Perception checks don't reveal your true nature, but a successful Nature or Survival check against your spell DC reveals that you appear to be a stone that is strangely new to the area. While in this form, you can observe everything around you, using your normal senses. As a stone, your AC is 23, and only status bonuses, status penalties, circumstance bonuses, and circumstance penalties affect you. Any successes and critical successes you roll on Reflex saves are failures

spell->Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
spell->Detect Magic.description:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

spell->Elemental Counter.name: Elemental Counter
spell->Elemental Counter.description:
Trigger You or a creature within 60 feet rolls a saving throw against a spell with the earth, fire, metal, plant, water, or wood trait, or are targeted by a spell attack with such a trait.

Requirements You have a spell slot from which you could Cast a Spell of the triggering spell's countering element; see text.

Each element in the elemental cycle counters another, and you can use your elemental spells to protect against elements they counter. You lose your spell slot as if you had cast the triggering spell. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell, using the rank of the spell you lost for the counteract rank. You can lose a plant or wood spell to counter earth, an earth spell to counter water, a water spell to counter fire, a fire spell to counter metal, or a metal spell to counter plant or wood.

spell->Glass Shield.name: Glass Shield
spell->Glass Shield.description:
You summon a layer of clear glass to keep you from harm. This counts as using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.xjGwis0uaC2305pm]{Raise a Shield} action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} with the glass shield. It has Hardness 2. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. When you Shield Block, the shield explodes in a shower of glass. If creature that broke it is within 5 feet, the shards deal 1d4 piercing damage to that creature with a basic Reflex save. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.oDDS6D2KTjpbA491]{Spell Effect: Glass Shield}

Heightened (3rd) The shield has Hardness 4, and the damage increases to 3d4.

Heightened (5th) The shield has Hardness 7, and the damage increases to 4d4.

Heightened (7th) The shield has Hardness 10, and the damage increases to 5d4.

Heightened (9th) The shield has Hardness 12, and the damage increases to 6d4.

spell->Interposing Earth.name: Interposing Earth
spell->Interposing Earth.description:
Trigger You are the target of a Strike or would attempt a Reflex save against a damaging area effect.

You raise a flimsy barrier of earth to shield you from harm. This barrier is 1 inch thick, 5 feet long, 5 feet high, and must be placed on the border between two squares. This barrier appears between you and the source of the triggering effect and grants you standard cover against the triggering effect. If you would be damaged by the triggering effect despite this barrier, the barrier is destroyed, and the damage dealt to you is reduced by 2. The barrier remains in place for 3 rounds (or until destroyed). It has AC 5, 2 Hardness, and 5 Hit Points.

Heightened (4th) The damage reduced increases to 8, the barrier's hardness increases to 8, and the barrier's Hit Points increases to 20.

spell->Scatter Scree.name: Scatter Scree
spell->Scatter Scree.description:
A jumble of rocks cascades into the area. The scattering rocks deal 2d4 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex save). The ground in the area becomes difficult terrain for the duration of the spell. A creature can Interact to clear a square of this scree.

If you cast this spell again, any previous scatter scree you've cast ends.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

spell->Shattering Gem.name: Shattering Gem
spell->Shattering Gem.description:
A large gem floats around the target in an erratic pattern. The gem has 5 Hit Points. Each time a creature Strikes the target, the target attempts a @Check[flat|dc:11|showDC:all]. On a success, the gem blocks the attack, so the attack first damages the gem and then applies any remaining damage to the target. If the gem is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it shatters, immediately dealing 1d8 slashing damage (basic Reflex save) to the creature that destroyed it, as long as that creature is within 10 feet of the target.

Heightened (+1) The gem has 5 additional Hit Points, and the damage dealt by its detonation increases by 1d8.

spell->Shockwave (At Will).name: Shockwave (At Will)
spell->Shockwave (At Will).description:
You create a wave of energy that ripples through the earth. Terrestrial creatures in the affected area must attempt a Reflex save to avoid stumbling as the shockwave shakes the ground.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of its next turn.

Failure The creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Critical Failure As failure, plus the creature takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

Heightened (+1) The area increases by 5 feet (to a 20-foot cone at 2nd rank, and so on).

spell->Tremor Signs.name: Tremor Signs
spell->Tremor Signs.description:
You send a series of tremors, no longer than a short sentence of speech, toward your target. If the target is within range and connected to the same body of earth as you, the vibrations reach the target through the ground. You need neither line of sight nor line of effect, so a target on another floor of a building is a valid target.

The target can give a brief, vibrational response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn, but they must be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered to you through tremors you feel, as with the original message. The tremors impart a clear meaning only if you and the target know that meaning, such as three tremors for a specific warning, two for another. Neither of you can impart a nuanced or new meaning using this spell.

A creature that has tremorsense can feel the vibrations from this spell if the creature is within range of the vibrations at any point during their journey to any target.

Heightened (4th) The spell can target up to 5 creatures.

action->Geomancy.name: Geomancy
action->Geomancy.description: Whenever Vesperix casts a spell with the earth trait, they gain resistance to physical damage (except adamantine) equal to the spell's rank for 1 round.

action->Crystal Detonation.name: Crystal Detonation
action->Crystal Detonation.description: All tracking crystals embedded in a creature that the xiomorn trooper can see within 300 feet immediately shatter and are destroyed. For each crystal destroyed in this way, the creature takes @Damage[1d12[piercing]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:37|basic] save.

action->Fighting Formation.name: Fighting Formation
action->Fighting Formation.description: The trooper Steps and makes a melee Strike. Up to two other xiomorn troopers within 15 feet can Step as a reaction.

action->Tracking Crystal.name: Tracking Crystal
action->Tracking Crystal.description: After the xiomorn trooper deals damage with a crystal shard Strike, a glowing green crystal embeds itself in the target's body. The crystal sheds dim light for 10 feet. While a creature has at least one crystal embedded in its body, all xiomorn troopers gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]] the creature and to Survival checks to [[/act track]] the creature. In addition, all xiomorn troopers gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against the creature. A creature can Interact to remove all tracking crystals embedded in themselves or an adjacent creature.

spell->Wall of Stone (At Will).name: Wall of Stone (At Will)
spell->Wall of Stone (At Will).description:
You shape a wall of solid stone. You create a 1-inch-thick wall of stone up to 120 feet long, and 20 feet high. You can shape the wall's path, placing each 5 feet of the wall on the border between squares. The wall doesn't need to stand vertically, so you can use it to form a bridge or set of stairs, for example. You must conjure the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost.

Each 10-foot-by-10-foot section of the wall has AC 10, Hardness 14, and 50 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. A destroyed section of the wall can be moved through, but the rubble created from it is difficult terrain.

Heightened (+2) The Hit Points of each section of the wall increase by 15.

spell->Exploding Earth (At Will).name: Exploding Earth (At Will)
spell->Exploding Earth (At Will).description:
You throw a hard-packed ball of earth and stone at a creature, and the projectile explodes upon impact. Attempt a spell attack against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 4d6 bludgeoning damage plus 1d6 bludgeoning splash damage. On a critical hit, double the initial damage, but not the splash damage, and the target you hit must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 2d6, and the splash damage increases by 1d6.

spell->Scatter Scree.name: Scatter Scree
spell->Scatter Scree.description:
A jumble of rocks cascades into the area. The scattering rocks deal 2d4 bludgeoning damage (basic Reflex save). The ground in the area becomes difficult terrain for the duration of the spell. A creature can Interact to clear a square of this scree.

If you cast this spell again, any previous scatter scree you've cast ends.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

action->Absorb Earth.name: Absorb Earth
action->Absorb Earth.description: A geomantic incant is powered by elemental earth energy. Any time it would be affected by another creature's spell that has the earth trait, it regains Hit Points equal to the rank of the spell.

action->Unstable Magic.name: Unstable Magic
action->Unstable Magic.description:
A roiling incant is as much a mass of unstable magic as it is a creature. Is isn't living or undead, nor is it even a construct. It can't be healed or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.bT3skovyLUtP22ME]{Repaired} and is destroyed at 0 Hit Points, though it naturally recovers a number of Hit Points equal to its @Damage[(@actor.level*@actor.system.abilities.con.mod)[healing]]{level × its Constitution modifier} each day.

Each time a roiling incant casts one of its non-cantrip spells, it drains its own magic to do so, taking @Damage[5[force]] damage.

Ghost Mold.name: Ghost Mold
Ghost Mold.description: A patch of black mold releases spoors when living creatures approach.
Ghost Mold.reset: Unless entirely eradicated (typically with acid or fire), the mold regrows over the course of 2 weeks.

action->Moldy Death.name: Moldy Death
action->Moldy Death.description: If a creature dies while taking persistent damage from the ghost mold spores, a new patch of mold blossoms from their corpse. The GM might decide that the creature's spirit rises as a ghost or other undead.

action->Spore Burst.name: Spore Burst
action->Spore Burst.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A living creature moves adjacent to the mold or the mold is included in the area of a vitality effect

Effect The mold releases a burst of spores in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]. Any creature in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:32|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:frightened,inflicts:confused] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[4d12[void]|options:area-damage] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[8d12[void],2d12[persistent,void]|options:area-damage] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for as long as it remains frightened.

action->Slow.name: Slow
action->Slow.description: A ghost mold zombie is permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and can't use reactions.

action->Vitality Spasm.name: Vitality Spasm
action->Vitality Spasm.description:
Frequency once per round

Trigger The ghost mold zombie takes vitality damage

Effect A burst of paranoia-inducing spores emerges from the zombie in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10]. All creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29|options:area-effect,inflicts:frightened] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3}.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature doesn't treat any creature as an ally for as long as it remains frightened.

action->Fearsome Exposure.name: Fearsome Exposure
action->Fearsome Exposure.description: Due to ongoing exposure to the spores that blanket a ghost mold zombie, a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the zombie doesn't automatically reduce the value of its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition at the end of its turn.

Illusory Safeguard.name: Illusory Safeguard
Illusory Safeguard.description: A phantasmal version of Itelybis appears to strike down a thief.
Illusory Safeguard.disable: @Check[occultism|dc:30] or @Check[thievery|dc:30] (master) to disable the runes or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (6th rank; counteract DC 30) to counteract them
Illusory Safeguard.stealth: (expert) to notice runes etched into the chest lid

action->Phantom Strike.name: Phantom Strike
action->Phantom Strike.description:
Trigger A creature attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick the Lock} on the chest

Effect An illusory ayindilar elf appears and drives their sword into the chest of the triggering creature, dealing @Damage[(4d12+30)[mental]] damage (@Check[will|dc:30|basic] save).

spell->Foresight.name: Foresight
spell->Foresight.description:
You gain a sixth sense that warns you of danger that might befall the target of the spell. If you choose a creature other than yourself as the target, you create a psychic link through which you can inform the target of danger. This link is a mental effect. Due to the amount of information this spell requires you to process, you can't have more than one foresight spell in effect at a time. Casting foresight again ends the previous foresight. While foresight is in effect, the target gains a +2 status bonus to initiative rolls and isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} creatures or when flanked. In addition, you gain the following reaction: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VOEWhPQfN3lvHivK]{Foresight}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.X9Na6IK8FSPcTuoc]{Spell Effect: Foresight}

spell->Phantasmagoria.name: Phantasmagoria
spell->Phantasmagoria.description:
You fill the targets' minds with endless images, like countless dreams and lives colliding with each other. The onrushing information deals @Damage[16d6[mental]] damage to each target, depending on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and can't use reactions until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} until the start of your next turn.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and is confused for 1 minute.

spell->Scrying.name: Scrying
spell->Scrying.description:
You magically spy on a creature of your choice. Scrying works like @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance}, except that the image you receive is less precise, insufficient for teleport and similar spells. Instead of creating an eye in a set location within 500 feet, you instead create an eye that manifests just above the target. You can choose a target either by name or by touching one of its possessions or a piece of its body. If you haven't met the target in person, scrying's DC is 2 lower, and if you are unaware of the target's identity (perhaps because you found an unknown creature's fang at a crime scene), the DC is instead 10 lower.

The effect of scrying depends on the target's Will save.

Critical Success The spell fails and the target is temporarily immune for 1 week. The target also gains a glimpse of you and learns its rough distance and direction from you.

Success The spell fails and the target is temporarily immune for 1 day.

Failure The spell succeeds.

Critical Failure The spell succeeds, and the eye follows the target if it moves, traveling up to 60 feet per round.

spell->Spellwrack.name: Spellwrack
spell->Spellwrack.description:
You cause any spells cast on the target to spill out their energy in harmful surges. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success Whenever the target becomes affected by a spell with a duration, the target takes @Damage[2d12[persistent,force]] damage. Each time it takes persistent force damage from spellwrack, it reduces the remaining duration of spells affecting it by 1 round. Only a successful @Check[arcana] check against your spell DC can help the target recover from the persistent damage; the curse and the persistent damage end after 1 minute.

Failure As success, but the curse and persistent damage do not end on their own.

Critical Failure As failure, but the persistent force damage is @Damage[4d12[persistent,force]].

spell->Truesight.name: Truesight
spell->Truesight.description: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

spell->Curse of Death.name: Curse of Death
spell->Curse of Death.description:
Your patron wraps a hand around your target's heart. The target must attempt a Fortitude saving throw. Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune to all curses of death for 1 day.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is afflicted with the curse of death at stage 1, and the stage of the curse can't increase beyond stage 1.

Failure The target is afflicted with the curse of death at stage 1.

Critical Failure The target is afflicted with the curse of death at stage 2

Curse of Death (curse, death, void) This curse ends when the spell ends

Stage 1 @Damage[(max(4,(@item.rank)-1))d6[void]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[(max(8,@item.rank+3))d6[void]] damage and fatigued (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[(max(12,@item.rank+7))d6[void]] damage and fatigued (1 round)

Stage 4 death

Heightened (+1) Increase the void damage taken on a success and during the first three stages of the curse by 1d6.

spell->Invoke Spirits.name: Invoke Spirits
spell->Invoke Spirits.description:
Ragged apparitions of the dead rise to stalk the living. They deal 2d4 mental damage and 2d4 void damage to each living creature in the area, with a basic Will save. Additionally, creatures that critically fail the save are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

On subsequent rounds, the first time you Sustain the Spell each round, you can move the area up to 30 feet within the range of the spell. Living creatures in the new area must attempt saves with the same effects as above, except that critically failing doesn't make them flee.

Heightened (+2) The mental damage and void damage each increase by 1d4.

spell->Slither.name: Slither
spell->Slither.description:
A mass of snakes made of shadow rise up to capture creatures in the area. Each creature in the area when you Cast the Spell takes 3d6 piercing damage and 1d6 persistent poison damage from a biting snake, and it's grabbed or restrained depending on its Reflex save. A creature that ends its turn in the area must also attempt this save, even if it's already grabbed or restrained by the snakes. You can Dismiss the spell.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by a snake. The snakes' [[/act escape]] DC is equal to your spell DC. A creature can attack a snake to release the creature. A snake's AC is equal to your spell DC, and it's destroyed if it takes 12 or more damage at once. New snakes continually regrow as long as the spell lasts, so destroying snakes doesn't prevent slither from capturing more creatures.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by a snake.

Heightened (+2) The persistent poison damage increases by 1d6 and snake HP increases by 6.

spell->Wave of Despair.name: Wave of Despair
spell->Wave of Despair.description:
You inflict despair on creatures in the area. The effects for each creature are determined by its Will save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success For 1 round, the creature can't use reactions and must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

Failure As success, but the duration is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature is automatically slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) The area increases to a 60-foot cone.

spell->Confusion.name: Confusion
spell->Confusion.description:
You befuddle your target with strange impulses, causing it to act randomly. The effects are determined by the target's Will save. You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target babbles incoherently and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute, with no save to end early.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Fly.name: Fly
spell->Fly.description:
The target can soar through the air, gaining a fly Speed equal to its Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.MuRBCiZn5IKeaoxi]{Spell Effect: Fly}

Heightened (7th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

spell->Nightmare.name: Nightmare
spell->Nightmare.description:
You send disturbing nightmares to your target. The next time the target falls asleep, it must attempt a Will save. If you know the target only by name and have never met them, the target gets a +4 circumstance bonus to the Will save.

Critical Success The target suffers no adverse effects and is temporarily immune for 1 week.

Success The target experiences the nightmares but suffers no adverse effects other than unpleasant memories.

Failure The target experiences the nightmares and awakens @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}.

Critical Failure The target experiences the nightmares, awakens Fatigued, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} until it is no longer Fatigued.

spell->Suggestion.name: Suggestion
spell->Suggestion.description:
Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Haste.name: Haste
spell->Haste.description:
Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}

spell->Rouse Skeletons.name: Rouse Skeletons
spell->Rouse Skeletons.description:
Misshapen skeletal forms erupt from a solid surface, such as a stone floor, and fill the burst. The area they fill is difficult terrain. Their grasping claws deal 2d6 slashing damage to creatures on the ground in the area when the skeletons first appear with a basic Reflex save.

On subsequent rounds, the first time you Sustain the Spell each round, you can move the area of skeletons up to 20 feet within the range of the spell and deal 2d6 slashing damage with a basic Reflex save to each creature in the new area.

Damaging or destroying the skeletons is irrelevant, as new bones pull forth from the ground to repair and replace any that are obliterated.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

spell->Blur (Self Only, At Will).name: Blur (Self Only, At Will)
spell->Blur (Self Only, At Will).description: The target's form appears blurry. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

spell->Final Sacrifice.name: Final Sacrifice
spell->Final Sacrifice.description:
You channel disruptive energies through the bond between you and your minion, causing it to violently explode. The target is immediately slain, and the explosion deals 6d6 fire damage to creatures within 20 feet of it with a basic Reflex save. If the target has the cold or water trait, the spell deals cold damage and has the cold trait instead of the fire trait. Attempting to cast this spell targeting a creature that you temporarily seized control of, such as an undead commanded by bind undead, automatically fails and breaks the controlling effect.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.
spell->Final Sacrifice.target: 1 creature with the minion trait that you summoned or permanently control

spell->Invisibility.name: Invisibility
spell->Invisibility.description:
Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

spell->Revealing Light.name: Revealing Light
spell->Revealing Light.description:
A wave of magical light washes over the area. You choose the appearance of the light, such as colorful, heatless flames or sparkling motes. A creature affected by revealing light is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}. If the creature was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead. If the creature was already concealed for any other reason, it is no longer concealed.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The light affects the creature for 2 rounds.

Failure The light affects the creature for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The light affects the creature for 10 minutes.

spell->See the Unseen.name: See the Unseen
spell->See the Unseen.description:
Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}

spell->Stupefy.name: Stupefy
spell->Stupefy.description:
You dull the target's mind, depending on its Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} for 1 minute.

spell->Daze.name: Daze
spell->Daze.description:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

spell->Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
spell->Detect Magic.description:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

spell->Dizzying Colors.name: Dizzying Colors
spell->Dizzying Colors.description:
You unleash a swirling multitude of colors that overwhelms creatures based on their Will saves.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round, and dazzled for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The creature is stunned for 1 round and blinded for 1 minute.

spell->Enfeeble.name: Enfeeble
spell->Enfeeble.description:
You sap the target's strength, depending on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} for 1 minute.

spell->Guidance.name: Guidance
spell->Guidance.description:
You ask for the guidance of supernatural entities, granting the target a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}

spell->Illusory Disguise (At Will).name: Illusory Disguise (At Will)
spell->Illusory Disguise (At Will).description:
You create an illusion that causes the target to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise is typically good enough to hide their identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell changes their appearance and voice, but not mannerisms. You can change the appearance of its clothing and worn items, such as making its armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties the target might take for disguising itself as a dissimilar creature, gives a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through the disguise, and lets the target add its level to such Deception checks even if untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (3rd) The target can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 willing creatures. If you target multiple creatures, you can choose a different disguise for each target, but none can impersonate a specific individual. You can Dismiss each disguise individually or all collectively.

Heightened (7th) As 4th, but you can choose disguises that impersonate specific individuals. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

spell->Life Boost.name: Life Boost
spell->Life Boost.description:
Life force from your patron floods into the target, ensuring they can continue doing your patron's will for just a little longer. The target gains fast healing 2.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.NQZ88IoKeMBsfjp7]{Spell Effect: Life Boost}

Heightened (+1) The fast healing increases by 2.

spell->Phantom Pain.name: Phantom Pain
spell->Phantom Pain.description:
Illusory pain wracks the target, dealing 2d4 mental damage and @Damage[(@item.level)d4[persistent,mental]] damage. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes full initial damage but no persistent damage, and the spell ends immediately.

Failure The target takes full initial and persistent damage, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. If the target recovers from being Sickened, the persistent damage ends and the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d4 and the persistent damage by 1d4.

spell->Shield.name: Shield
spell->Shield.description:
You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

spell->Ventriloquism (At Will).name: Ventriloquism (At Will)
spell->Ventriloquism (At Will).description:
Whenever you speak or make any other sound vocally, you can make your vocalization seem to originate from somewhere else within 60 feet, and you can change that apparent location freely as you vocalize. Any creature that hears the sound can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The spell's duration increases to 1 hour, and you can also change the tone, quality, and other aspects of your voice. Before a creature can attempt to disbelieve your illusion, it must actively attempt a Perception check or otherwise use actions to interact with the sound.

spell->Void Warp.name: Void Warp
spell->Void Warp.description:
You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

action->+1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

action->+4 Status Bonus to Will vs. Ment.name: +4 Status Bonus to Will vs. Mental

action->Thin of Blood.name: Thin of Blood
action->Thin of Blood.description: Zyss serpentfolk recover slowly from injuries. When they take physical damage from a critical hit, they gain @Damage[2d4[persistent,bleed]] damage. They take a –2 circumstance penalty to flat checks to recover from persistent damage and saving throws against afflictions.

action->Effortless Concentration.name: Effortless Concentration
action->Effortless Concentration.description:
Trigger Jotzi's turn begins.

Effect Jotzi immediately gains the effects of the Sustain action, allowing her to extend the duration of one of her active spells.

action->Sovereign Serpentfolk Venom.name: Sovereign Serpentfolk Venom
action->Sovereign Serpentfolk Venom.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:40|options:damaging-effect,inflicts:enfeebled]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[3d4[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[6d4[poison]] damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round)

action->Impose Order.name: Impose Order
action->Impose Order.description: When Kajasiel succeeds at an Intimidation check to [[/act demoralize]] a creature, the creature can't use reactions for as long as they remain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} by Kajasiel's Demoralize.

action->Twin Bond.name: Twin Bond
action->Twin Bond.description: Kajasiel can communicate telepathically with Daehalyan as long as they are within 100 feet of each other.

action->Advisor's Counsel.name: Advisor's Counsel
action->Advisor's Counsel.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect Kajasiel telepathically @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aids} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.sn2hIy1iIJX9Vpgj]{Points Out} a creature to his brother Daehalyan.

action->Silencing Strike.name: Silencing Strike
action->Silencing Strike.description: Kajasiel makes a bola Strike. On a hit, the weapon wraps around the target's throat, crushing its larynx. The creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:33] save or be unable to speak for 1 round ([[/gmr 1d4#Silencing Strike rounds]] on a critical failure).

action->Sword Specialist.name: Sword Specialist
action->Sword Specialist.description: When Kajasiel critically hits with a curve blade, the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of Kajasiel's next turn.

Knucklehead.name: Knucklehead
Knucklehead.publicNotes:
Knuckleheads are fleshwarps named after the oversized hand that sprouts from their neck in place of a skull. Their dangling, armor-plated arms are equally disproportionate, even in comparison to their massive frames, which range in size from 10 to 14 feet tall. Knuckleheads can use their arms either as a second pair of legs or to deliver stone-shattering punches. They feed by crushing a victim in their head-hand, the palm of which is split by a toothy maw.

It's often said that encountering a fleshwarp is evidence there's an even greater monster nearby: the cruel being that tortured the fleshwarp into its distorted form. The Darklands are home to many such monsters, both the fleshwarps and their creators.

Failed Experiments

Knuckleheads are the product of an effort to turn prisoners into obedient servants, but it turns out that a brain isn't an optional luxury when creating the perfect laborer. Driven by hunger and blind instinct, knuckleheads hunted their creators and fellow prisoners alike. Now that they've escaped into the Darklands, they prowl pitch-black caverns, attracted by the smell of flesh.

action->Tighten Grip.name: Tighten Grip
action->Tighten Grip.description:
Trigger A creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by the knucklehead attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape}

Effect The DC of the Escape check is increased by 2 and the creature takes @Damage[2d10[bludgeoning]] damage.

action->All Fours.name: All Fours
action->All Fours.description: The knucklehead drops to all fours, or stands upright. While on all fours and not @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, the knucklehead's walking Speed is 50 feet, its [[/act long-jump]] and [[/act high-jump]] distance is equal to its Speed, and it can't use its arm hand Strike.

action->Devouring Squeeze.name: Devouring Squeeze
action->Devouring Squeeze.description:
Requirements The knucklehead has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} in its head hand

Frequency once per round

Effect The knucklehead squeezes the creature, gnawing hungrily through both armor and flesh. The creature takes @Damage[(2d10+10)[bludgeoning]] damage, and if the creature is wearing armor with Hardness 14 or lower, the armor is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken}. If the creature isn't wearing armor or if its armor is already broken, the creature instead takes an additional @Damage[2d10[piercing]] damage, and the knucklehead regains Hit Points equal to the amount of piercing damage dealt.

action->Ground Slam.name: Ground Slam
action->Ground Slam.description: The knucklehead slams the ground with an arm hand. The ground in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:10] becomes difficult terrain. If the knucklehead has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} in its arm hand, that creature takes @Damage[(2d10+10)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage. Other creatures in the area take @Damage[3d10[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage with a basic @Check[reflex|dc:30|options:area-effect,inflicts:prone] save. A creature that fails the save also falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

action->Shattering Punch.name: Shattering Punch
action->Shattering Punch.description: The knucklehead's arm hand Strikes ignore an object's Hardness. If the knucklehead Strikes a stone surface, it breaks off a boulder-sized chunk of stone, which it can use to make rock Strikes.

action->Switch Hands.name: Switch Hands
action->Switch Hands.description:
Requirements The knucklehead has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} in one of its arm hands

Effect The knucklehead moves the creature to its head hand. The creature is restrained. While the creature is restrained, they can't breathe or talk. The knucklehead can't have more than one creature restrained in its head hand.

Lapidarium Defense Grid.name: Lapidarium Defense Grid
Lapidarium Defense Grid.description: The crystal lattices on the walls activate in turn, each projecting a hard-light grid of uniform, 6-inch-wide cells. The glowing grids then briskly sweep across the chamber in sequence, dicing organic matter they touch into precise cubes.
Lapidarium Defense Grid.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:40] (master) or @Check[arcana|dc:37] (expert) to physically or magically sabotage one of the lattices. Deactivating or destroying all four lattices deactivates the hazard.
Lapidarium Defense Grid.reset: The trap resets immediately once no living creatures occupy the lapidarium.
Lapidarium Defense Grid.routine: (2 actions) On each of the hazard's actions, a grid sweeps across the lapidarium in the following repeating sequence: west, north, east, south. A lattice that has been deactivated continues to use one of the trap's actions when its turn in the sequence is reached, but it no longer generates a grid.
Lapidarium Defense Grid.stealth: (master) to recognize the chamber as a deadly magical trap

action->Activate.name: Activate
action->Activate.description:
Trigger A creature moves at least 10 feet into the room

Effect A transparent, hard-light barrier springs up across the lapidarium entrance. The barrier allows organic material to enter the area but not exit until the southernmost lattice is deactivated. The lattice on the west wall flares with light, and the hazard rolls initiative.

action->Sweep.name: Sweep
action->Sweep.description: A grid generated by a lattice on one side of the room moves 30 feet to the opposite side, striking everything in its path. Contact with the grid inflicts @Damage[16d8[force]] damage, with a @Check[reflex|dc:41|basic] save. A character who makes a successful @Check[perception|dc:39] check to [[/act seek]] after observing at least one Sweep notices that a 10-foot gap momentarily appears in each grid just before it reaches the pillar in the center of the room, making the two spaces adjacent to the pillar and facing toward the active lattice safe from each Sweep.

0.label: To Hide or Sneak among inscriptions

spell->Chain Lightning.name: Chain Lightning
spell->Chain Lightning.description:
You discharge a powerful bolt of lightning at the target, dealing 8d12 electricity damage. The target must attempt a basic Reflex save. The electricity arcs to another creature within 30 feet of the first target, jumps to another creature within 30 feet of that target, and so on. You can end the chain at any point. You can't target the same creature more than once, and you must have line of effect to all targets. Roll the damage only once, and apply it to each target (halving or doubling as appropriate for its saving throw outcome). The chain ends if any one of the targets critically succeeds at its save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12.
spell->Chain Lightning.target: 1 creature, plus any number of additional creatures

spell->Disintegrate.name: Disintegrate
spell->Disintegrate.description:
A black tracer bolt flies toward your target, and upon making contact intensifies into a powerful destructive beam. Make a spell attack against the target. If you hit an object or force construct (such as a wall of force), it's destroyed with no save unless it's an artifact or similarly powerful. A single casting can destroy no more than a 10-foot cube of matter. If you hit a creature, it takes 12d10 damage (no damage type) with a basic Fortitude save. If you critically hit, the target gets a result one degree of success worse than the outcome of its Fortitude save. A creature reduced to 0 HP is blasted to fine powder; its gear remains.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d10.
spell->Disintegrate.target: 1 creature, unattended object, or force construct

spell->Disintegrate.name: Disintegrate
spell->Disintegrate.description:
A black tracer bolt flies toward your target, and upon making contact intensifies into a powerful destructive beam. Make a spell attack against the target. If you hit an object or force construct (such as a wall of force), it's destroyed with no save unless it's an artifact or similarly powerful. A single casting can destroy no more than a 10-foot cube of matter. If you hit a creature, it takes 12d10 damage (no damage type) with a basic Fortitude save. If you critically hit, the target gets a result one degree of success worse than the outcome of its Fortitude save. A creature reduced to 0 HP is blasted to fine powder; its gear remains.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d10.
spell->Disintegrate.target: 1 creature, unattended object, or force construct

spell->Truesight (Constant).name: Truesight (Constant)
spell->Truesight (Constant).description: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

spell->Wall of Force.name: Wall of Force
spell->Wall of Force.description:
You form an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} wall of pure magical force up to 50 feet long and up to 20 feet high. The wall has no discernible thickness. You must create the wall in an unbroken open space so its edges don't pass through any creatures or objects, or the spell is lost. The wall has AC 10, Hardness 30, and 60 Hit Points, and it's immune to critical hits and precision damage. The wall blocks physical effects from passing through it, and because it's made of force, it blocks incorporeal and ethereal creatures as well. Teleportation effects can pass through the barrier, as can visual effects (since the wall is invisible). Wall of force is immune to counteracting effects of its level or lower, but the wall is automatically destroyed by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate} spell of any rank.

Heightened (+2) The Hit Points of the wall increase by 20.

spell->Slither.name: Slither
spell->Slither.description:
A mass of snakes made of shadow rise up to capture creatures in the area. Each creature in the area when you Cast the Spell takes 3d6 piercing damage and 1d6 persistent poison damage from a biting snake, and it's grabbed or restrained depending on its Reflex save. A creature that ends its turn in the area must also attempt this save, even if it's already grabbed or restrained by the snakes. You can Dismiss the spell.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by a snake. The snakes' [[/act escape]] DC is equal to your spell DC. A creature can attack a snake to release the creature. A snake's AC is equal to your spell DC, and it's destroyed if it takes 12 or more damage at once. New snakes continually regrow as long as the spell lasts, so destroying snakes doesn't prevent slither from capturing more creatures.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by a snake.

Heightened (+2) The persistent poison damage increases by 1d6 and snake HP increases by 6.

spell->Toxic Cloud.name: Toxic Cloud
spell->Toxic Cloud.description:
You conjure a poisonous fog. This functions as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist}, except the area moves 10 feet away from you each round. You deal 6d8 poison damage to each breathing creature that starts its turn in the spell's area. You can Dismiss the spell.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

spell->Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
spell->Detect Magic.description:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

action->Truescript.name: Truescript
action->Truescript.description: A living rune can't speak, but it can sculpt its form into complicated scripts and pictographs that can be understood by any creature with the ability to read written language. A living rune can also understand any written or spoken language.

action->Backdrop.name: Backdrop
action->Backdrop.description: When a creature attempts to Strike a living rune and critically misses, the attacker hits the surface (a canvas, wall, or so on) behind the living rune. This might damage the surface or the attacker's weapon, at the GM's discretion.

action->Surface-Bound.name: Surface-Bound
action->Surface-Bound.description: A living rune can move only along flat surfaces. If the surface it's on is destroyed (such as a portrait hit by a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sxQZ6yqTn0czJxVd]{Fireball} spell or a wall being smashed), the rune takes @Damage[7d6[untyped]] damage and is shunted to the nearest flat surface. If there is no flat surface within 5 feet, the rune is destroyed.

spell->Vital Beacon.name: Vital Beacon
spell->Vital Beacon.description:
Vitality radiates outward from you, allowing others to supplicate and receive healing. Once per round, either you or an ally can use an Interact action to supplicate and lay hands upon you to regain Hit Points. Each time the beacon heals someone, it decreases in strength. It restores @Damage[(@item.rank)d10[healing,vitality]|shortLabel] Hit Points to the first creature, @Damage[(@item.rank)d8[healing,vitality]|shortLabel] Hit Points to the second, @Damage[(@item.rank)d6[healing,vitality]|shortLabel] Hit Points to the third, and @Damage[(@item.rank)d4[healing,vitality]|shortLabel] Hit Points to the fourth, after which the spell ends. You can have only one vital beacon active at a time.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.WWtSEJGwKY4bQpUn]{Spell Effect: Vital Beacon}

Heightened (+1) The beacon restores one additional die of Hit Points each time it heals, using the same die size as the others for that step.

spell->Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
spell->Detect Magic.description:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

spell->Heal.name: Heal
spell->Heal.description:
You channel vital energy to heal the living or damage the undead. If the target is a willing living creature, you restore 1d8 Hit Points. If the target is undead, you deal that amount of vitality damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing a living creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse vital energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the burst.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

spell->Mindlink.name: Mindlink
spell->Mindlink.description: You link your mind to the target's mind and mentally impart to that target an amount of information in an instant that could otherwise be communicated in 10 minutes.

spell->Share Lore.name: Share Lore
spell->Share Lore.description:
You share your knowledge with the touched creatures. Choose one Lore skill in which you're trained. The targets become trained in that Lore skill for the duration of the spell.

Heightened (3rd) The duration of the spell is 1 hour, and you can target up to five creatures.

Heightened (5th) The duration of the spell is 8 hours, you can target up to five creatures, and you can share up to two Lore skills in which you're trained.

spell->Stabilize.name: Stabilize
spell->Stabilize.description: Life energy shuts death's door. The target loses the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying} condition, though it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} at 0 Hit Points.

spell->Telekinetic Projectile.name: Telekinetic Projectile
spell->Telekinetic Projectile.description:
You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at the target. Make a spell attack roll against the target. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

action->Dimensional Refuge.name: Dimensional Refuge
action->Dimensional Refuge.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect Life shunts an adjacent willing or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} target into a personal pocket dimension capable of holding one creature of size Large or smaller for an indefinite period of time. While inside the dimensional refuge, the creature is invulnerable to all damage, can't be targeted, and no rounds elapse for any conditions, afflictions, or other ongoing effects it has, but it can't perceive the outside world or take actions except to exit the refuge as a free action, emerging into a space adjacent to Life. Life can expel the refuge's current occupant as a free action.

action->Gestalt.name: Gestalt
action->Gestalt.description: Life grants the following additional spells to any gestalt she joins: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.x5rGOmhDRDVQPrnW]{Field of Life}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.C0D2eqzTAhiKm4j9]{Gentle Breeze}

Malfunctioning Engine.name: Malfunctioning Engine
Malfunctioning Engine.description: The malfunctioning ecdysis engine warps the flesh of creatures that enter the room.
Malfunctioning Engine.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:32] (expert) or @Check[occultism|dc:32] (expert) four times to disrupt the magic, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (6th rank, DC 30) to cleanse the vaultline's effect on the ecdysis engine. Closing the sluice in area B1 drains power from the engine and counts as one success, as does calibrating the control panel in area B23. For each success, reduce the hazard's number of actions by 1.
Malfunctioning Engine.routine:
(4 actions) The warpline focuses on a random creature in the room, which must make a @Check[fortitude|dc:36] save. A single creature can't be targeted more than once on the hazard's turn.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and gains a +1 status bonus to further saves vs. the hazard.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} (determined randomly), or its enfeebled or clumsy condition value increases by 1 (to a maximum of 4 for each condition).

Critical Failure As failure, except the condition value becomes 2 or increases by 2.

action->Fleshwarp.name: Fleshwarp
action->Fleshwarp.description:
Trigger A creature enters the ecdysis engine

Effect The warpline arcs throughout the area. Each creature in the room must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:36|options:area-effect,inflicts:sickened] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and gains a +1 status bonus to further saves against the hazard.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}.

Critical Failure The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Mavanagiti.name: Mavanagiti
Mavanagiti.publicNotes:
Once the servant of a deity, the graveknight champion returned as an undead after a life cut short in service to their god.

When a fearsome combatant falls in battle, the warrior's vengeful spirit can sometimes fuse with their armor, creating a graveknight.

spell->Eclipse Burst.name: Eclipse Burst
spell->Eclipse Burst.description:
A globe of freezing darkness explodes in the area, dealing 8d10 cold damage to creatures in the area, plus an additional 8d4 void damage to living creatures. Each creature in the area must attempt a Reflex save.

If the globe overlaps with an area of magical light or affects a creature affected by magical light, eclipse burst attempts to counteract the light effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} by the darkness for an unlimited duration.

Heightened (+1) The cold damage increases by 1d10 and the void damage against the living increases by 1d4.

spell->Execute.name: Execute
spell->Execute.description:
You point at a creature and invoke the demise of all things. The target takes 70 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. If the target is undead or otherwise has void healing, the spell loses the death and void traits and gains the vitality trait, and the target takes 70 vitality damage with a basic Fortitude save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 10.

spell->Execute.name: Execute
spell->Execute.description:
You point at a creature and invoke the demise of all things. The target takes 70 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. If the target is undead or otherwise has void healing, the spell loses the death and void traits and gains the vitality trait, and the target takes 70 vitality damage with a basic Fortitude save.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 10.

spell->Divine Immolation.name: Divine Immolation
spell->Divine Immolation.description:
Divine flames scour creatures within the area. Creatures take 6d6 fire damage and @Damage[(@item.level -3)d6[persistent,fire]] damage. The divine power within the flames scorches the spirit as well; a creature takes spirit damage instead of fire damage from divine immolation if that would be more detrimental to the creature (as determined by the GM).

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage and no persistent damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and persistent damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and double persistent damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6 and persistent damage increases by 1d6.

spell->Chilling Darkness.name: Chilling Darkness
spell->Chilling Darkness.description:
You shoot an utterly cold ray of darkness tinged with unholy energy. Make a ranged spell attack. The ray deals 5d6 cold damage. If the target has the holy trait, you deal an extra 5d6 spirit damage.

Critical Success The target takes double damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

If the ray passes through an area of magical light or targets a creature affected by magical light, chilling darkness attempts to counteract the light. If you need to determine whether the ray passes through an area of light, draw a line between yourself and the spell's target.

Heightened (+1) The cold damage increases by 2d6, and the spirit damage against holy creatures increases by 2d6.

spell->Fireball.name: Fireball
spell->Fireball.description:
A roaring blast of fire detonates at a spot you designate, dealing 6d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

spell->Fireball.name: Fireball
spell->Fireball.description:
A roaring blast of fire detonates at a spot you designate, dealing 6d6 fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

spell->Spiritual Armament.name: Spiritual Armament
spell->Spiritual Armament.description:
You create a ghostly, magical echo of one weapon you're wielding or wearing and fling it. Attempt a spell attack roll against the target's AC, dealing 2d8 damage on a hit (or double damage on a critical hit). The damage type is the same as the chosen weapon (or any of its types for a versatile weapon). The attack deals spirit damage instead if that would be more detrimental to the creature (as determined by the GM). This attack uses and contributes to your multiple attack penalty. After the attack, the weapon returns to your side. If you sanctify the spell, the attacks are sanctified as well. Each time you Sustain the spell, you can repeat the attack against any creature within 120 feet.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d8.

spell->Daze.name: Daze
spell->Daze.description:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

spell->Divine Lance.name: Divine Lance
spell->Divine Lance.description:
You unleash a beam of divine energy. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 2d4 spirit damage (double damage on a critical hit).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

spell->Shield.name: Shield
spell->Shield.description:
You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

spell->Void Warp.name: Void Warp
spell->Void Warp.description:
You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

action->Clutching Armor.name: Clutching Armor
action->Clutching Armor.description:
Trigger A creature attempts to move away from the graveknight

Effect The graveknight's armor animates and attempts to Grab the triggering creature. It makes an Athletics check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} using the graveknight's Athletics modifier – 2.

The armor can continue to Grapple the creature normally. Since the armor is grappling the creature, the graveknight doesn't need a free hand to do so.

action->Channel Magic.name: Channel Magic
action->Channel Magic.description: The graveknight redirects magical energies through its armor, allowing it to deliver magic through an attack. The graveknight Casts a Spell that takes 1 or 2 actions to cast and requires a spell attack modifier. The effects of the spell don't occur immediately but are imbued into an attack instead. The graveknight then makes a melee Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack. The spell is coupled with the attack, using the attack roll result to determine the effects of both the Strike and the spell. This counts as two attacks for the graveknight's multiple attack penalty but doesn't apply the penalty until after they've completed Channeling Magic. The graveknight can't use Channel Magic again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Channel Magic]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Devastating Blast.name: Devastating Blast
action->Devastating Blast.description:
The graveknight unleashes a @Template[cone|distance:30] of energy. Creatures in the area take @Damage[18d6[mental]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:38|basic|options:area-effect] save).

The graveknight can use this ability once every [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Devastating Blast]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Graveknight's Curse.name: Graveknight's Curse
action->Graveknight's Curse.description:
This curse affects anyone who wears a graveknight's armor for at least 1 hour.

Saving Throw @Check[will|dc:42|options:inflicts:doomed] save

Onset 1 hour

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} and cannot remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2}, speed penalty of –10 feet, and cannot remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 3 dies and transforms into the armor's graveknight.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.6rnB7nK6J6zF4vea]{Effect: Graveknight's Curse}

action->Ruinous Weapons.name: Ruinous Weapons
action->Ruinous Weapons.description: Any weapon or unarmed attack Mavanagiti uses gains the effects of the +1 greater striking weapon and a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.uz3JCjRvkE44jxMd]{Greater Fearsome} weapon rune.

action->Weapon Master.name: Weapon Master
action->Weapon Master.description: The graveknight has access to the critical specialization effects of any weapons it wields.

Memory of the Plateau.name: Memory of the Plateau
Memory of the Plateau.description: An illusion of the Storval Plateau fills creatures with a longing for the surface.
Memory of the Plateau.disable: @Check[stealth|dc:36] (master) to approach the crystal sphere followed by @Check[thievery|dc:38] (master) to remove the sphere from the pedestal without triggering the hazard, or @Check[arcana|dc:36] or @Check[occultism|dc:36] (expert) twice to unweave the illusion, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (8th rank; counteract DC 34)
Memory of the Plateau.reset: The hazard deactivates automatically after 1 minute. The hazard reactivates after 1 hour unless the crystal is removed from the pedestal.
Memory of the Plateau.routine:
(1 action) The hazard fills the hearts of those affected by the illusion with a longing for the surface. Each creature in the area that hasn't disbelieved the illusion attempts a @Check[will|dc:38|options:area-effect,inflicts:stupefied,inflicts:slowed] save. This is an emotion and mental effect.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 round.

action->Illusory Vista.name: Illusory Vista
action->Illusory Vista.description:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 10 feet of the crystal sphere or the sphere is removed from the pedestal

Effect The chamber seems to fade away and is replaced by an image of the Storval Plateau at night. Each creature in the area must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:40] save or become convinced they've been transported to Golarion's surface. A creature can disbelieve the illusion by succeeding at a Perception check to [[/act seek dc=40]]. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Monofilamental.name: Monofilamental
Monofilamental.publicNotes:
A monofilamental is a floating bubble made of glowing, crystalline strands. From this complex web of interconnected threads, a highly ordered intelligence emerges, one capable of turning each of its delicate skeins into an unbreakable, serrating lash.

Drifting through the Darklands on subterranean air currents, a monofilamental looks as delicate as a soap bubble or spider web. In fact, the psychic intelligence that animates the monofilamental exerts an unbreakable mental control over each of its strands, granting them unrivaled tensile strength. A single monofilamental thread can slice through steel or stone, to say nothing of the flesh and bone toward which the construct unerringly drifts. If monofilamental thread could be harvested, it would both be a powerful tool and a fearsome weapon; when a monofilamental dies, however, so too does the mental force that fortifies each thread.

Collective Network

Although intelligent, monofilamentals are spun by—and exist only to serve—a species of non-sapient spiders native to the Plane of Earth. Working collectively through instinct, clusters of these extraplanar spiders spin webs of unmatched complexity, some of which awaken to sentience as monofilamentals. Once created, a monofilamental bends its brilliant psychic intellect toward a narrow purpose: fetching meat for its arachnid creators.

spell->Interplanar Teleport (To Plane of.name: Interplanar Teleport (To Plane of Earth or the Universe Only)
spell->Interplanar Teleport (To Plane of.description:
Requirements You have a planar key for the destination plane, used as a locus

You and your allies traverse the barriers between planes of existence. The targets move to another plane, such as the Plane of Fire, the Netherworld, or the Outer Rifts. You must know the destination plane exists and use a magic planar key created from material from that plane as a locus for the spell. While the planar keys for most prominent planes are uncommon, just like the spell interplanar teleport, more obscure planes and demiplanes often have rare or possibly even unique planar keys.

The spell is highly imprecise, and you appear 1d20×25 miles from the last place one of the targets (of your choice) was located the last time that target traveled to the plane. If it's the first time traveling to a particular plane for all targets, you appear at a random location on the plane. Interplanar teleport doesn't provide a means of return travel, though casting interplanar teleport again allows you to return to your previous plane unless there are extenuating circumstances.

spell->Telekinetic Haul (At Will).name: Telekinetic Haul (At Will)
spell->Telekinetic Haul (At Will).description: You move the target up to 20 feet, potentially suspending it in midair. When you Sustain the Spell, you can do so again, or you can shift your telekinetic focus to a different eligible target within range, moving it instead.
spell->Telekinetic Haul (At Will).target: 1 unattended object of up to 80 Bulk with no dimension longer than 20 feet

spell->Truespeech (Constant).name: Truespeech (Constant)
spell->Truespeech (Constant).description:
