You draw in the blood and life force of other creatures through your outstretched arms. You deal 12d6 void damage to living creatures in the area with a basic Fortitude save.

You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage a single creature takes from this spell; calculate these temporary Hit Points using the creature that took the most damage. You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

spell->Zealous Conviction.name: Zealous Conviction
spell->Zealous Conviction.description:
You bypass your targets' rational minds, instilling them with unshakable conviction and zeal. The targets each gain 12 temporary Hit Points and a +2 status bonus to Will saves against mental effects, as their faith overrides the signals from their own bodies and minds. If you tell a target to do something, it must comply with your request, though if it would normally find the task repugnant, it can attempt a Will save at the end of its turn each round due to the cognitive dissonance. On a success, it ends the spell's effects on itself entirely.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.nemThuhp3praALY6]{Spell Effect: Zealous Conviction}

Heightened (9th) The temporary Hit Points increase to 18, and the status bonus to Will saves increases to +3.

spell->Toxic Cloud.name: Toxic Cloud
spell->Toxic Cloud.description:
You conjure a poisonous fog. This functions as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9XHmC2JgTUIQ1CCm]{Mist}, except the area moves 10 feet away from you each round. You deal 6d8 poison damage to each breathing creature that starts its turn in the spell's area. You can Dismiss the spell.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

spell->Truespeech (Constant).name: Truespeech (Constant)
spell->Truespeech (Constant).description:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.

spell->Suggestion.name: Suggestion
spell->Suggestion.description:
Your honeyed words are difficult for creatures to resist. You suggest a course of action to the target, which must be phrased in such a way as to seem like a logical course of action to the target and can't be self-destructive or obviously against the target's self-interest. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and knows you tried to control it.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target immediately follows your suggestion. The spell has a duration of 1 minute, or until the target has completed a finite suggestion or the suggestion becomes self-destructive or has other obvious negative effects.

Critical Failure As failure, but the base duration is 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Blur (Self Only, At Will).name: Blur (Self Only, At Will)
spell->Blur (Self Only, At Will).description: The target's form appears blurry. It becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to Hide or Sneak.

spell->Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
spell->Detect Magic.description:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

spell->Divine Lance.name: Divine Lance
spell->Divine Lance.description:
You unleash a beam of divine energy. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 2d4 spirit damage (double damage on a critical hit).

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

spell->Harm.name: Harm
spell->Harm.description:
You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse void energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
spell->Harm.target: 1 living creature or 1 willing undead creature

spell->Harm (At Will).name: Harm (At Will)
spell->Harm (At Will).description:
You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse void energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
spell->Harm (At Will).target: 1 living creature or 1 willing undead creature

spell->Illusory Disguise (At Will).name: Illusory Disguise (At Will)
spell->Illusory Disguise (At Will).description:
You create an illusion that causes the target to appear as another creature of the same body shape, and with roughly similar height (within 6 inches) and weight (within 50 pounds). The disguise is typically good enough to hide their identity, but not to impersonate a specific individual. The spell changes their appearance and voice, but not mannerisms. You can change the appearance of its clothing and worn items, such as making its armor look like a dress. Held items are unaffected, and any worn item removed from the creature returns to its true appearance.

Casting illusory disguise counts as setting up a disguise for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} use of Deception; it ignores any circumstance penalties the target might take for disguising itself as a dissimilar creature, gives a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent others from seeing through the disguise, and lets the target add its level to such Deception checks even if untrained. You can Dismiss this spell.

Heightened (3rd) The target can appear as any creature of the same size, even a specific individual. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

Heightened (4th) You can target up to 10 willing creatures. If you target multiple creatures, you can choose a different disguise for each target, but none can impersonate a specific individual. You can Dismiss each disguise individually or all collectively.

Heightened (7th) As 4th, but you can choose disguises that impersonate specific individuals. You must have seen an individual to replicate its appearance, and must have heard its voice to replicate its voice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3Ktyd5F9lOPo4myk]{Spell Effect: Illusory Disguise}

spell->Message.name: Message
spell->Message.description:
You mouth words quietly, but instead of coming out of your mouth, they're transferred directly to the ears of the target. While others can't hear your words any better than if you normally mouthed them, the target can hear your words as if they were standing next to you. The target can give a brief response as a reaction, or as a free action on their next turn if they wish, but they must be able to see you and be within range to do so. If they respond, their response is delivered directly to your ear, just like the original message.

Heightened (3rd) The spell's range increases to 500 feet.

spell->Ventriloquism (At Will).name: Ventriloquism (At Will)
spell->Ventriloquism (At Will).description:
Whenever you speak or make any other sound vocally, you can make your vocalization seem to originate from somewhere else within 60 feet, and you can change that apparent location freely as you vocalize. Any creature that hears the sound can attempt to disbelieve your illusion.

Heightened (2nd) The spell's duration increases to 1 hour, and you can also change the tone, quality, and other aspects of your voice. Before a creature can attempt to disbelieve your illusion, it must actively attempt a Perception check or otherwise use actions to interact with the sound.

equipment->Religious Symbol of Abraxas.name: Religious Symbol of Abraxas
equipment->Religious Symbol of Abraxas.description: This piece of wood or silver is emblazoned with an image representing a deity. Some divine spellcasters, such as clerics, can use a religious symbol of their deity to use certain abilities and cast some spells. A religious symbol can be worn on the body on a chain or pin, or can be held.

action->Thin of Blood.name: Thin of Blood
action->Thin of Blood.description: Tenazki recovers slowly from injuries. When he takes physical damage from a critical hit, he gains @Damage[2d4[persistent,bleed]] damage. He takes a –2 circumstance penalty to flat checks to recover from persistent damage and saving throws against afflictions.

action->Biting Whip.name: Biting Whip
action->Biting Whip.description: Tenazki calls upon the power of Abraxus, briefly transforming the end of his whip into writhing viper. If Tenazki's next attack is to make a whip Strike, the target is also subjected to Potent Serpentfolk Venom.

action->Potent Serpentfolk Venom.name: Potent Serpentfolk Venom
action->Potent Serpentfolk Venom.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:39|options:damaging-effect,inflicts:enfeebled]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[4d4[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[8d4[poison]] damage and enfeebled 1 (1 round)

Terror Glyphs.name: Terror Glyphs
Terror Glyphs.description: Magical glyphs crawl across the floor, ceiling, and walls of the hallway.
Terror Glyphs.disable: @Check[acrobatics|dc:38] or @Check[athletics|dc:38] (expert) to move through the area before the glyph activates, @Check[arcana|dc:40] (expert) to unweave the glyph's animating magic, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank; counteract DC 36)

action->Terrifying Message.name: Terrifying Message
action->Terrifying Message.description:
Trigger A living creature moves into the trapped area

Effect The glyph scuttles in front of the triggering creature and rearranges itself to spell out a terrifying threat, such as "You are about to die." The creature attempts a @Check[will|dc:40|options:inflicts:fleeing,inflicts:frightened] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round. A fleeing creature moves toward the nearest trapped area, or in a random direction if no trapped areas remain.

action->Prone Difficulty.name: Prone Difficulty
action->Prone Difficulty.description: The thash takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its Reflex DC against [[/act trip]] attempts. While @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, the thash is upside down and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}. The thash must succeed at a @Check[athletics|dc:30] check to Stand.

action->Soft Underbelly.name: Soft Underbelly
action->Soft Underbelly.description: The thash has an AC of 24 against attacks made directly below it or directly above it while the thash is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

action->Splintery Shell.name: Splintery Shell
action->Splintery Shell.description: The thash has Hardness 10 against damage from sources directly above it. When the thash takes bludgeoning damage from a source directly above it, jagged splinters fly from its shell in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5]. Creatures in the area except the thash take @Damage[2d8[piercing]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:27|basic|options:area-effect] save).

The Antediluvian.name: The Antediluvian
The Antediluvian.languages: can't speak any language, telepathy 100 feet

action->Thoughtsense 60 feet.name: Thoughtsense 60 feet
action->Thoughtsense 60 feet.description: The raw nerve senses all non-mindless creatures at the listed range.

action->Accelerating Inquest.name: Accelerating Inquest
action->Accelerating Inquest.description:
The raw nerve mentally probes a creature within 100 feet, attempting an @Check[occultism|against:will] check against the creature's Will DC. On a success, the raw nerve can Step, and gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against that creature until the start of the raw nerve's next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.daNNIj1yrIL3Q4ys]{Effect: Accelerating Inquest}

action->Float.name: Float
action->Float.description: A raw nerve floats a few inches from the ground. As such, it can ignore difficult terrain.

action->Involuntary Reaction.name: Involuntary Reaction
action->Involuntary Reaction.description: A creature struck by a raw nerve's nerve ending strike must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:34] saving throw or be unable to use reactions until the start of its next turn.

action->Synaptic Overload.name: Synaptic Overload
action->Synaptic Overload.description:
The raw nerve releases a burst of mental energy in a @Template[cone|distance:30], dealing @Damage[6d12[mental]|options:area-damage] damage to each creature in the cone (@Check[will|dc:31|options:area-effect,damaging-effect,inflicts:stunned] save).

Critical Success The creature takes no damage.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}

Thisty Sands.name: Thisty Sands
Thisty Sands.description: Illusory spectators cry out for blood as tendrils of sand hold unwilling combatants in place.
Thisty Sands.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:38] or @Check[nature|dc:38] (master) twice to undo the magic that animates the sand, @Check[intimidation|dc:34] or @Check[performance|dc:34] (expert) twice to win over the crowd, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank; counteract DC 36)
Thisty Sands.reset: The hazard deactivates once no living creatures are in the room, resetting after 1 minute.
Thisty Sands.routine: (1 action) Tendrils of sand rise from the floor. Up to two creatures in the room must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:38|options:forced-movement,inflicts:prone] save. On a failed save, the tendrils wrap around the creature and move it to an unoccupied square closest to the center of the arena. If the creature was Flying, the tendril also pulls it to the ground. On a critical failure, the creature is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. The tendrils then collapse back into the floor.

action->The Crowd Goes Wild!.name: The Crowd Goes Wild!
action->The Crowd Goes Wild!.description:
Trigger A living creature enters the area

Effect The chamber fills with the sound of cheering spectators. Each creature in the area attempts a @Check[will|dc:40|options:area-effect,inflicts:confused,inflicts:stunned] saving throw with the effects below. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is rattled briefly by the roar and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The cries of the bloodthirsty crowd overwhelm the creature. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute but can attempt a new save at the end of each of their turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure The creature is confused for 1 minute or until the haunt is disabled, with no save to end early.

action->Endless Suffering.name: Endless Suffering
action->Endless Suffering.description:
The type of torture that killed a tormented determines the effect of their Tortured Gaze. The damage type listed in parentheses deactivates their regeneration and is their damage weakness.

Lost in a Maze (mental) The tormented lost themselves in the confusing depths of the Ghostfang Coils. For 1 minute, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1}.

action->Tortured Gaze.name: Tortured Gaze
action->Tortured Gaze.description:
30 feet, or 60 feet if the tormented is at 125 HP or lower.

The psychic agony of a tormented spills into the world around them, creating murderous hallucinations replicating the tormented's last moments. A non-undead creature that ends its turn in the aura must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:32|options:area-effect] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute. While it has a condition from Tortured Gaze, a creature can't gain a new condition from the aura.

action->Scream in Agony.name: Scream in Agony
action->Scream in Agony.description: Each creature in the tormented's Tortured Gaze aura takes @Damage[14d6[mental]|options:area-effect,inflicts:sickened] damage (@Check[will|dc:34|basic] save). A creature that fails is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). The tormented can't Scream in Agony again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Scream in Agony]]{1d4 rounds} but recharges the ability whenever they take damage from an attacker's critical hit or their own critical failure on a saving throw.

spell->Warp Mind.name: Warp Mind
spell->Warp Mind.description:
You scramble a creature's mental faculties and sensory input. The target must attempt a Will saving throw. Regardless of the result of that save, the target is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes. Warp mind's effects happen instantly, so @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} and other effects that counteract spells can't counteract them. However, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6dDtGIUerazSHIOu]{Wish} rituals and abilities that can remove non-magical effects can still counteract the effects.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target spends the first action on its next turn with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} condition.

Failure The target is Confused for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Confused permanently.

spell->Truesight.name: Truesight
spell->Truesight.description: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).

spell->Flicker.name: Flicker
spell->Flicker.description:
You flicker quickly between your current plane and another. You gain resistance 5 to all damage, except force. At the end of each of your turns, you automatically teleport 10 feet in a random direction, as determined by the GM. You can Sustain the spell to teleport in this way.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ZlsuhS9J0S3PuvCO]{Spell Effect: Flicker}

Heightened (+2) The resistance increases by 3.

spell->Fly.name: Fly
spell->Fly.description:
The target can soar through the air, gaining a fly Speed equal to its Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.MuRBCiZn5IKeaoxi]{Spell Effect: Fly}

Heightened (7th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

spell->Runic Impression.name: Runic Impression
spell->Runic Impression.description:
Your unarmed attacks or your weapon gain the benefits of a weapon rune you choose when you cast this spell: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Wm0X7Pfd1bfocPSv]{Corrosive}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.XszNvxnymWYRaoTp]{Flaming}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.M5M1WJ5KzbYfRGsY]{Frost}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.JQdwHECogcTzdd8R]{Ghost Touch}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.qlunQzfnzPQpMG6U]{Returning}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.NVst7e69agGG9Qwd]{Shock}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.dTxbaa7HSiJbIuNN]{Thundering}. If you cast runic impression on a weapon, this spell ends if you cease holding the weapon, with the exception of throwing a returning weapon. If this spell would give a weapon more property runes than its normal maximum, one of the existing property runes (your choice) is suppressed until the spell ends. For unarmed attacks, if this spell would give you more property runes than you could have from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.FNDq4NFSN0g2HKWO]{Handwraps of Mighty Blows}, one of the existing property runes is similarly suppressed.

Heightened (8th) Add keen to the list of runes you can choose as well as the greater versions of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.vQUIUAFOTOWj3ohh]{Corrosive}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.RSZwUlCzUX7Nb4UA]{Flaming}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Sexud7FdxIrg50vU]{Frost}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.TEa1oKZbwsOvC6TZ]{Shock}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Lb7F2BR9X9TF1vjX]{Thundering}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Vc97f8ChfcZzprlZ]{Spell Effect: Runic Impression}
spell->Runic Impression.target: you or one weapon you're wielding

spell->Translocate.name: Translocate
spell->Translocate.description:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

spell->Haste.name: Haste
spell->Haste.description:
Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round only for Strike and Stride actions.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}

spell->Paralyze.name: Paralyze
spell->Paralyze.description:
You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Paralyze.name: Paralyze
spell->Paralyze.description:
You block the target's motor impulses before they can leave its mind, threatening to freeze the target in place. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 4 rounds. At the end of each of its turns, it can attempt a new Will save to reduce the remaining duration by 1 round, or end it entirely on a critical success.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Slow.name: Slow
spell->Slow.description:
You dilate the flow of time around the target, slowing its actions.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 minute.

Heightened (6th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Vampiric Feast.name: Vampiric Feast
spell->Vampiric Feast.description:
Your touch leeches the lifeblood out of a target to empower yourself. You deal 6d6 void damage to the target. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the void damage the target takes (after applying resistances and the like). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

spell->Blood Vendetta.name: Blood Vendetta
spell->Blood Vendetta.description:
Requirements You can bleed.

Trigger A creature deals piercing, slashing, or persistent bleed damage to you.

You curse the target, punishing it for having the audacity to spill your blood. The target takes 2d6 persistent bleed damage and must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half the persistent bleed damage.

Failure The target takes the full persistent bleed damage. Until the bleeding stops, the target has weakness 1 to piercing and slashing damage. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.buXx8Azr4BYWPtFg]{Spell Effect: Blood Vendetta (Failure)}

Critical Failure As failure, but the target takes double the persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+2) The persistent bleed damage increases by 2d6.

spell->Darkness.name: Darkness
spell->Darkness.description:
You create a shroud of darkness that prevents light from penetrating or emanating within the area. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of your darkness spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a globe of pure darkness.

Heightened (4th) Even creatures with darkvision (but not greater darkvision) can barely see through the darkness. They treat targets seen through the darkness as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}.

spell->Dispel Magic.name: Dispel Magic
spell->Dispel Magic.description: You unravel the magic behind a spell or effect. Attempt a counteract check against the target. If you successfully counteract a magic item, the item becomes a mundane item of its type for 10 minutes. This doesn't change the item's non-magical properties. If the target is an artifact or similar item, you automatically fail.
spell->Dispel Magic.target: 1 spell effect or unattended magic item

spell->False Vitality.name: False Vitality
spell->False Vitality.description:
You augment your flesh with the energies typically used to manipulate the undead. You gain 10 temporary Hit Points.

Heightened (+1) The temporary Hit Points increase by 3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.PANUWN5xXC20WBg2]{Spell Effect: False Vitality}

spell->Gecko Grip.name: Gecko Grip
spell->Gecko Grip.description:
Tiny clinging hairs sprout across the creature's hands and feet, offering purchase on nearly any surface. The target gains a climb Speed equal to its Speed.

Heightened (5th) The duration increases to 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.qn7uO5Ih01yLJot7]{Spell Effect: Gecko Grip}

spell->Invisibility.name: Invisibility
spell->Invisibility.description:
Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

Heightened (4th) The spell lasts 1 minute, but it doesn't end if the target uses a hostile action.

spell->Resist Energy.name: Resist Energy
spell->Resist Energy.description:
A shield of elemental energy protects a creature against one type of energy damage. Choose acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. The target and its gear gain resistance 5 against the damage type you chose.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.con2Hzt47JjpuUej]{Spell Effect: Resist Energy}

Heightened (4th) The resistance increases to 10, and you can target up to two creatures.

Heightened (7th) The resistance increases to 15, and you can target up to five creatures.

spell->See the Unseen.name: See the Unseen
spell->See the Unseen.description:
Your gaze pierces through illusions and finds @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} creatures and spirits. You can see invisible creatures as though they weren't invisible, although their features are blurred, making them @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} and difficult to identify. You can also see incorporeal creatures, like ghosts, phased through an object from within 10 feet of an object's surface as blurry shapes seen through those objects. Subtler clues also grant you a +2 status bonus to checks you make to disbelieve illusions.

Heightened (5th) This spell has a duration of 8 hours.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.T5bk6UH7yuYog1Fp]{Spell Effect: See the Unseen}

spell->Command.name: Command
spell->Command.description:
You shout a command that's hard to ignore. You can command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, or stand in place. It can't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.A72nHGUtNXgY5Ey9]{Delay} or take any reactions until it has obeyed your command. The effects depend on the target's Will save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure For the first action on its next turn, the creature must use a single action to do as you command.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to obey your command.

Heightened (5th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

spell->Daemonic Pact.name: Daemonic Pact
spell->Daemonic Pact.description:
You call upon the powers of Abaddon to grant you the assistance of a daemon. You call upon a daemon whose level can be no more than double daemonic pact's spell rank, two daemons whose levels are each at least 2 less than double the spell rank, or three daemons whose levels are each at least 3 less than double the spell rank.

Critical Success You conjure the daemon or daemons, and they require nothing in return for their service.

Success You conjure the daemon or daemons, who serve you willingly, but require a sacrifice in the form of spilled blood (either another creature's or your own).

Failure You don't conjure any daemons.

Critical Failure You don't conjure any daemons, and the self-sacrifice required to perform the ritual leaves you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} if the spell rank is 5 or higher).
spell->Daemonic Pact.primarycheck: Religion (expert; you must be a daemon or an urdefhan)

spell->Daze.name: Daze
spell->Daze.description:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

spell->Detect Magic.name: Detect Magic
spell->Detect Magic.description:
You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an invisibility potion) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

spell->Dimensional Assault.name: Dimensional Assault
spell->Dimensional Assault.description:
You tumble through a small rift in space itself, making a short dimensional hop to better position yourself for a devastating surprise attack. Teleport to any space in range you can see that's within reach of an enemy, and then make a melee Strike against that enemy. If you attempt to bring another creature with you when you teleport—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is disrupted.

Heightened (5th) The range is equal to your Speed.

spell->Enfeeble.name: Enfeeble
spell->Enfeeble.description:
You sap the target's strength, depending on its Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 3} for 1 minute.

spell->Fear.name: Fear
spell->Fear.description:
You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

spell->Figment.name: Figment
spell->Figment.description:
You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.GkmbTGfg8KcgynOA]{Create a Diversion} with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.2Hg3a06gZCSnUgSA]{Spell Effect: Figment}

spell->Fleet Step.name: Fleet Step
spell->Fleet Step.description:
You gain a +30-foot status bonus to your Speed.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ThFug45WHkQQXcoF]{Spell Effect: Fleet Step}

spell->Gentle Landing.name: Gentle Landing
spell->Gentle Landing.description:
Trigger a creature within range is falling

You raise a magical updraft to arrest a fall. The target's fall slows to 60 feet per round, and the portion of the fall during the spell's duration doesn't count when calculating falling damage. If the target reaches the ground while the spell is in effect, it takes no damage from the fall. The spell ends as soon as the target lands.

spell->Grim Tendrils.name: Grim Tendrils
spell->Grim Tendrils.description:
Tendrils of darkness curl out from your fingertips and race through the air. You deal 2d4 void damage and @Damage[(@item.level)[bleed]] damage to living creatures in the line. Each living creature in the line must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the void damage and no persistent bleed damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes double void damage and double persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The void damage increases by 2d4, and the persistent bleed damage increases by 1.

spell->Harm.name: Harm
spell->Harm.description:
You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse void energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.
spell->Harm.target: 1 living creature or 1 willing undead creature

spell->Harm.name: Harm
spell->Harm.description:
You channel void energy to harm the living or heal the undead. If the target is a living creature, you deal 1d8 void damage to it, and it gets a basic Fortitude save. If the target is a willing undead creature, you restore that amount of Hit Points. The number of actions you spend when Casting this Spell determines its targets, range, area, and other parameters.

1 The spell has a range of touch.

2 (concentrate) The spell has a range of 30 feet. If you're healing an undead creature, increase the Hit Points restored by 8.

3 (concentrate) You disperse void energy in a @Template[emanation|distance:30]. This targets all living and undead creatures in the area.

Heightened (+1) The amount of healing or damage increases by 1d8, and the extra healing for the 2-action version increases by 8.

spell->Read Aura.name: Read Aura
spell->Read Aura.description:
You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.J6OhRNSN23KzOPRL]{Spell Effect: Read Aura}

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.

spell->Shield.name: Shield
spell->Shield.description:
You raise a magical shield of force. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. The shield has Hardness 5. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.Jemq5UknGdMO7b73]{Spell Effect: Shield}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield's Hardness increases by 5.

spell->Sure Strike.name: Sure Strike
spell->Sure Strike.description:
The next time you make an attack roll before the end of your turn, roll it twice and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden}. You are then temporarily immune to sure strike for 10 minutes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.fpGDAz2v5PG0zUSl]{Spell Effect: Sure Strike}

action->Necrotic Decay.name: Necrotic Decay
action->Necrotic Decay.description: When an urdefhan dies, their translucent flesh quickly rots away and sublimates into a foul-smelling gas that fills a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] around the body. This gas deals @Damage[16d6[void]|options:area-damage] damage to creatures in this area as their flesh curdles and rots (@Check[fortitude|dc:33|basic|options:area-effect] save).

action->Preternatural Parry.name: Preternatural Parry
action->Preternatural Parry.description:
Trigger Triaza is targeted by a Strike or spell attack roll, or she is about to roll a saving throw against a spell effect

Effect Triaza raises her guard. She gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against the triggering effect until the start of her next turn.

action->Bloodthirsty Spellstrike.name: Bloodthirsty Spellstrike
action->Bloodthirsty Spellstrike.description:
Triaza channels her desire to devour her prey into her weapon. She expends a casting of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.N1Z1oLPdBxaSgrEE]{Vampiric Feast} of a rank of her choosing, then makes a Strike with her rhoka sword. On a hit, the target must also save against vampiric feast of the chosen rank.

This ability counts as two attacks for the purposes of calculating Triaza's multiple attack penalty. Triaza can't use Bloodthirsty Spellstrike again until she uses Rapid Recharge, casts a conflux spell, or uses a single action (which has the concentrate trait) to recharge it.

action->Rapid Recharge.name: Rapid Recharge
action->Rapid Recharge.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect Triaza recharges Bloodthirsty Spellstrike.

action->Wicked Bite.name: Wicked Bite
action->Wicked Bite.description:
Requirements The urdefhan damaged a creature with a jaws Strike on their last action

Effect The urdefhan maintains contact, turning the creature's flesh translucent around the site of the injury. The target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:36] save or be affected by drain blood or drain vitality (the urdefhan's choice). If the jaws Strike was a critical hit, the creature is affected by both effects, using the same save result for both.

  • Drain Blood The urdefhan drinks some of the creature's blood. On a failed save, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and the urdefhan regains 5 HP (or, on a critical failure, it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and the urdefhan regains 10 HP).

  • Drain Vitality The urdefhan draws out some of the creature's vital essence. The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} for 1 hour on a failed save (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} for 1 hour on a critical failure).

Unraveling Fleshwarp.name: Unraveling Fleshwarp
Unraveling Fleshwarp.description: A surge of fleshwarping magic causes a creature's flesh to unravel.
Unraveling Fleshwarp.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:30] (trained) or @Check[occultism|dc:30] (expert) to disrupt the magic, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (6th rank, DC 28) to counteract the fleshwarping

action->Perforate.name: Perforate
action->Perforate.description:
Trigger A creature touches the dam

Effect The triggering creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:32|options:damaging-effect] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to the effects of warpline hazards for 1 hour.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure Strips of the creature's flesh peel away, exposing muscle and bone. The creature takes @Damage[(3d10+14)[slashing]] damage and suffers a –4 circumstance penalty to Acrobatics and Athletics checks for 1 day.

Critical Failure As failure, except the penalty to Acrobatics and Athletics checks lasts for 1 week.

action->Alchemical Chambers.name: Alchemical Chambers
action->Alchemical Chambers.description:
A noxious needler's body contains six alchemical chambers filled with different substances. When a noxious needler's ability calls upon a randomly determined alchemical effect, roll 1d6 and consult the following (if you roll the result of a chamber that was shattered, there is no alchemical effect):

action->Alchemical Rupture.name: Alchemical Rupture
action->Alchemical Rupture.description:
When a noxious needler takes physical damage from a critical hit or is affected by a shatter spell, one glass chamber within its body shatters, spewing alchemical liquid in a @Template[emanation|distance:10]. Roll on the alchemical chambers list to determine which one shatters—on a roll of 1–5, creatures in the area take 15d6 damage of the appropriate type (DC 40 basic Reflex). action->Alchemical Injection.description:
When a noxious needler hits a creature with a syringe Strike, roll 1d6 on the alchemical chambers list to determine the additional effect of the attack. The syringe deals an additional 2d6 damage of the appropriate type (or exposes the target to the sickness effect, as appropriate).

action->Generate Bomb.description:
The needler fills an empty vial from one of its alchemical chambers to create a bomb and then makes a bomb Strike. Roll 1d6 on the table below. Vault Lifter.name: Vault Lifter
Vault Lifter.publicNotes:
Vault lifters are sentient stone constructs roughly carved into the semblance of giant xiomorns. Each vault lifter is encircled by a spinning ring, called a rotor, which grants the lifter the ability to fly.

Xiomorns created vault lifters to help construct their vaults throughout the Plane of Earth and across the Universe. With the ability to airlift heavy burdens and possessed with enough intelligence to carry out complex instructions, vault lifters were valuable lieutenants in the xiomorns' vast terraforming projects. Vault lifters were intended to be more than simple laborers, however; they were also built as weapons of war. In combat, vault lifters spin their rotors into fearsome buzz saws capable of propelling them at high speeds and slicing foes in half.

Abandoned Guardians

While some vault lifters continue to serve living xiomorns, others have been left behind in long-abandoned locations. Over the years, many of these forgotten vault lifters have completed their assignments and deactivated themselves. Others continue to perform some unending task, such as "keep this area clean," "prevent unauthorized entry," or "I'll be back in a bit—wait for my return." After millennia spent in solitude, some abandoned vault lifters become fanatical about their final orders, spinning them into complex philosophical systems heavy with moral significance.

action->Activate Rotor.name: Activate Rotor
action->Activate Rotor.description:
The vault lifter's rotor spins, becoming a buzzing blur. While the rotor is activated, the lifter gains a fly Speed of 40 feet. The spinning rotor also creates an aura in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:5] around the lifter. Any creature that enters or starts its turn in the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:34|options:damaging-effect,forced-movement,inflicts:prone] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected, and the vault lifter's rotor is deactivated. The lifter loses its fly Speed and aura until it Activates Rotor again.

Success The creature takes @Damage[2d8[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[4d8[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[8d8[slashing]|options:area-damage] damage. If the creature isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by the vault lifter, they are pushed back 15 feet and knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

action->Carry.name: Carry
action->Carry.description: A vault lifter can Fly at half Speed while it has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, carrying that creature along with it.

action->Draw In.name: Draw In
action->Draw In.description: The vault lifter attempts to [[/act reposition]] a creature it has @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, moving the creature into a space adjacent to it. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the lifter's multiple attack penalty.

action->Overdrive.name: Overdrive
action->Overdrive.description:
Requirements The vault lifter's rotor is activated

Effect The lifter Flies up to three times its Fly Speed in a straight line without triggering reactions. At the end of this flight, the lifter must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:40] saving throw. On a failure, the lifter's rotor is deactivated.

Vaultquake.name: Vaultquake
Vaultquake.description: The retreating vaultline causes a series of cave-ins.
Vaultquake.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:31], @Check[nature|dc:31], @Check[occultism|dc:31], or @Check[religion|dc:31] (master) to disperse the ley line's power as it retreats, or @Check[survival|dc:27] (expert) to predict where rubble might fall next. The DC of the flat check for this round (see Routine) is increased by 4 on a success or by 8 on a critical success. Increasing the flat check DC to 21 or higher stabilizes the cavern, ending the hazard.
Vaultquake.reset: After 4 rounds, the hazard ends automatically as the vaultquake subsides.
Vaultquake.routine: (1 action) The GM rolls a @Check[flat|dc:9] to determine if a cave-in occurs. On a successful check, falling rubble deals @Damage[(2d12+15)[bludgeoning]] damage to a random PC (@Check[reflex|dc:30|basic] save). On a critical success, the collapse deals @Damage[(2d12+15)[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage] damage to all the PCs instead.
Vaultquake.stealth: to see the ley line energy retreating throughout the cavern

action->Disorienting Screech.name: Disorienting Screech
action->Disorienting Screech.description:
Trigger The vaultline retreats.

Effect Each creature in the area attempts a @Check[will|dc:30|options:area-effect,inflicts:stunned,inflicts:stupefied] save with the following effects. The hazard then rolls initiative.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} and stupefied 1 for an indefinite duration.

Vemerak.name: Vemerak
Vemerak.publicNotes:
A vemerak looks like a mishmash between a burrowing insect and a grotesque sea creature, stretched and warped to a titanic scale. When it first bursts from a half-buried hidey-hole or scuttles down a narrow tunnel, its form is obscured by a tangle of spidery legs and tentacles. Only when an unfortunate witness views the creature up close is the vemerak's immense, ant-like body revealed. At one end of the beast, glittering eyes blink above short, wriggling tentacles and serrated mouthparts, while three tail-like tentacles wave and slap at the other. Blue-green mold flakes from the vemerak's flanks, and wherever the mold lands, magic around it fades.

With its clicking pincers and corrosive bile, the vemerak is often mistaken for a mindless predator like a scorpion or spider, but it has enough wit to speak to its intended prey. A vemerak's words are often cruel, focused on the pain it plans to inflict on its victims.

Though most often encountered in the Darklands, in ages past vemeraks roamed Golarion's surface, leaving chaos and suffering in their wake. The creatures have even been encountered on other planets in Golarion's solar system, such as the distant Triaxus.

Rovagug's Pets

Though in its natural state a vemerak is hardly more intelligent than a predatory animal, its mind is linked to the urges and drives of the god Rovagug. When slaughter is in the offing, a vemerak becomes capable of laying traps with cunning and foresight, and its otherwise limited vocabulary grows poetic as it threatens foes with suffering and death. The farther a vemerak travels from Golarion's depths, the more tenuous its link to Rovagug becomes. Vemeraks found in the shallower parts of the Darklands are as mindless as cave worms or giant insects.

action->Dispelling Spores.name: Dispelling Spores
action->Dispelling Spores.description: 30 feet. The vemerak's body exudes antimagic spores. When an ongoing spell effect enters the aura, the vemerak automatically attempts to counteract it ([[/r 1d20+28 #Counteract]]{+28} counteract modifier, 7th rank). The spell effect is then temporarily immune to the vemerak's dispelling spores for 24 hours.

action->Bile Spray.name: Bile Spray
action->Bile Spray.description: The vemerak breathes a blast of pale blue corrosive bile that deals @Damage[14d6[acid]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[type:line|distance:90] (@Check[reflex|dc:34|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:sickened] save). A creature that fails its save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). The vemerak can't use Bile Spray again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Bile Spray]]{1d4 rounds}.

action->Earthquake.name: Earthquake
action->Earthquake.description: The vemerak digs its tentacles into the earth or stone beneath it. At the start of the vemerak's next turn, if the vemerak hasn't been moved or knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and is able to take actions, it creates the effects of an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.x7SPrsRxGb2Vy2nu]{Earthquake} spell, centered on the vemerak, without using an action to do so. The vemerak ignores difficult terrain and the penalty to attack rolls, AC, and skill checks created by shaking ground, and it can exclude itself from any other effects created by the earthquake.

action->Eyespots.name: Eyespots
action->Eyespots.description: A warpigrade can't see anything beyond 30 feet.

action->Tun State.name: Tun State
action->Tun State.description:
Trigger The warpigrade would be reduced to 0 Hit Points or would die due to starvation, suffocation, or similar environmental causes

Frequency once per week

Requirements The warpigrade isn't already in tun state

Effect The warpigrade doesn't die but instead remains at 1 Hit Point and curls into a dry ball, called a tun. While in this tun state, the warpigrade is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, doesn't need to eat, drink, or breathe, and doubles its resistance to 20. It remains in tun state indefinitely until covered in significant amounts of water, at which point it begins to rehydrate, gaining regeneration 5. The regeneration persists until it reaches maximum Hit Points. The warpigrade then exits its tun state.

action->Ingest Aspect.name: Ingest Aspect
action->Ingest Aspect.description:
Requirements The warpigrade has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} with its pincers

Effect The warpigrade makes a stylet Strike. If it succeeds, the warpigrade attempts to absorb some of the victim's essence. The creature attempts a @Check[fortitude|dc:33] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (determine randomly) for 1 round. If the creature becomes clumsy, the warpigrade gains a +1 status bonus to its AC and Reflex save for 1 round; if the creature becomes enfeebled, the warpigrade instead gains the bonus to its attack and damage rolls.

Failure As success, except if the creature is already clumsy or enfeebled, the condition value and corresponding status bonus increase by 1 (to a maximum of 4), and the effect lasts for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, except the condition value and status bonus increase by 2.

action->Vacuum Mouth.name: Vacuum Mouth
action->Vacuum Mouth.description:
Requirements The warpigrade doesn't have a target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}

Effect The warpigrade draws in air with its mouth. All creatures in a @Template[cone|distance:20] must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:30|options:area-effect,forced-movement] save or be pulled adjacent to the warpigrade. The warpigrade chooses one creature that failed its save, Grabbing the target in its claws and making a stylet Strike.

Wet Blanket.name: Wet Blanket
Wet Blanket.description: Wet Blanket's invisible spirit plays a discordant tune that confounds the senses.
Wet Blanket.disable: @Check[diplomacy|dc:40] or @Check[intimidation|dc:40] (expert) twice to convince Wet Blanket to stay silent, @Check[occultism|dc:42] or @Check[religion|dc:42] (master) to exorcise Wet Blanket's spirit, or @Check[performance|dc:38] (expert) twice to drown out Wet Blanket's music. A PC holding Wet Blanket's fiddle of the maestro gains a +2 item bonus to any check made to disable the haunt.
Wet Blanket.reset: Unless the haunt is disabled, Wet Blanket falls silent once all creatures leave the room. She returns if another creature moves adjacent to the gate.
Wet Blanket.routine:
(1 action; auditory, concentrate, emotion, incapacitation, mental) Wet Blanket's tune causes creatures who hear it to act irrationally. Each creature in the area attempts a @Check[will|dc:40|options:area-effect,inflicts:confused,inflicts:stunned|traits:auditory,concentrate,emotion,incapacitation,mental] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes immune to the tune for 1 minute.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 minute. They can attempt a new save at the end of each of their turns to end the confusion.

Critical Failure As failure, and the creature immediately attacks themself. The Strike doesn't give the creature a flat check to recover from the confusion.

action->Crescendo.name: Crescendo
action->Crescendo.description:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the iron gate

Effect Wet Blanket's discordant tune swells to a crescendo. Each creature in the area must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:42|options:area-effect,inflicts:stupefied] saving throw or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure). The hazard then rolls initiative.

Xiomorn Comm Trooper.name: Xiomorn Comm Trooper
Xiomorn Comm Trooper.publicNotes:
Xiomorn troopers are an elite military force formed from the ranks of xiomorn vault keepers. Armed with technology only they understand, xiomorn troopers hold the line against those who oppose the mysterious aims of the vault builders.

Many xiomorn troopers possess special training or equipment that helps them perform specific roles within their strike force. Comm troopers, for example, can communicate telepathically with their fellow troopers, while scout troopers surround themselves with fields of light-bending energy on their patrols. The batons of shock troopers carry charges of electricity that they use to stun their foes, while rad troopers are armed with explosives that release bursts of a sickening radiation, to which the troopers themselves are immune.

Mysterious Generals

Some xiomorn troopers consider themselves part of a single military organization led by a figure whose identity is unknown even to the highest-ranking troopers. Referred to only as the "Commander," this mysterious leader hands down orders along an extended, telepathic chain of command. In many Orvian vaults, the Commander is presumed to be a vault builder—or perhaps a fellow trooper in direct contact with the builders—though some troopers insist the Commander is simply an imaginary figurehead created to inspire loyalty. The fact that different squads of troopers have at times been given conflicting orders lends credence to the latter belief.

action->Crystal Detonation.name: Crystal Detonation

action->Fighting Formation.name: Fighting Formation
action->Fighting Formation.description: The trooper Steps and makes a melee Strike. Up to two other xiomorn troopers within 15 feet can Step as a reaction.

action->Tracking Crystal.name: Tracking Crystal
action->Tracking Crystal.description:
After the xiomorn trooper deals damage with a crystal shard Strike, a glowing green crystal embeds itself in the target's body. The crystal sheds dim light for 10 feet. While a creature has at least one crystal embedded in its body, all xiomorn troopers gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to [[/act seek]] the creature and to Survival checks to [[/act track]] the creature. In addition, all xiomorn troopers gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against the creature. A creature can Interact to remove all tracking crystals embedded in themselves or an adjacent creature.

Yig.name: Yig
Yig.languages: speak with animals (reptiles only), telepathy 100 feet
Yig.publicNotes:
To call Yig benign is perhaps too generous, but among the eldritch entities that comprise the Great Old Ones and Outer Gods, the word is indeed apropos. While those who worship Yig know that the patience of the so-called Father of Serpents is limited and expect no kindness from him, Yig nonetheless seeks vengeance against those who harm his beloved serpents—and sometimes his non-serpent worshippers as well.

Great Old Ones

Although Yig is one of the least powerful of the Great Old Ones, his might vastly outstrips that of most mortal creatures. He exists outside of the cycle of souls and is immortal—if a way exists that Yig can be permanently slain, none yet know it. Likewise, no one can say for certain where Yig's home world lies. Indeed, the Great Old One counts any world on which serpents might be found as his own.

Yig's Worshippers

Yig has worshippers on many worlds, and unlike most Great Old Ones, he sometimes takes notice of those who venerate him. He has even been known to reward his faithful from time to time—a trait not shared by the other Great Old Ones. Worship of Yig has long been a point of friction in sekmin society, where venerating deities other than Ydersius is often synonymous with treason. Additional information concerning Yig's worshippers, including his clerics, appears on pages 318–319 of Pathfinder Lost Omens Divine Mysteries.

spell->Gate.name: Gate
spell->Gate.description: You tear open a rift to another plane, creating a portal that creatures can travel through in either direction. This portal is vertical and circular, with a radius of 40 feet. The portal appears at a location of your choice on the destination plane, assuming you have a clear idea of both the destination's location on the plane and what the destination looks like. If you attempt to create a gate into or out of the realm of a deity or another similarly powerful being, that being can prevent the gate from forming.

spell->Control Weather.name: Control Weather
spell->Control Weather.description:
Area 2-mile-radius circle centered on you

You alter the weather, making it calm and normal for the season or choosing up to two effects based on the season.

  • Spring drizzle, heat, hurricane, sleet, thunderstorm, tornado
  • Summer drizzle, downpour, extreme heat, hail, heat
  • Autumn cold weather, fog, mild heat, sleet
  • Winter blizzard, mild cold, extreme cold, thaw

You can't specifically control the manifestations, such as the exact path of a tornado or the targets of lightning strikes.

Critical Success You change the weather as desired and can affect a larger area (up to a 5-mile-radius circle), or a longer duration (any number of additional d12 hours, up to 16d12).

Success You change the weather as desired.

Failure You fail to change the weather as desired.

Critical Failure The weather changes in an unanticipated way, determined by the GM but generally as contradictory to your true desires as possible (for instance, a terrible storm emerges when you would prefer good weather).

Heightened (9th) You can create unseasonable weather and contradictory weather effects, such as extreme cold and a hurricane. You can make the weather calm and normal weather for a different season or choose weather effects from any season's list.

spell->Dream Council.name: Dream Council
spell->Dream Council.description: When you Cast this Spell, any targets-including you-can choose to immediately fall asleep. The spell ends for any creatures that don't choose to fall asleep. Sleepers join a shared dream, where they can communicate with one another as though they were in the same room. Individual targets leave this shared dream upon awakening, and if all the targets awaken, the spell ends.
spell->Dream Council.target: up to 12 creatures you know by name and have met in person

spell->Awaken Animal.name: Awaken Animal
spell->Awaken Animal.cost: herbs, 1/5 the value on Creature Creation Rituals table
spell->Awaken Animal.description:
You grant intelligence to the target, transforming it into a beast. If it was previously an animal companion or minion, it can no longer serve as one.

Critical Success The target's Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma modifiers each increase to +2 if they were lower, and it becomes helpful to you for awakening it.

Success The target's Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma modifiers increase to +0 if they were lower and it becomes friendly to you for awakening it.

Failure You fail to awaken the target.

Critical Failure You accidentally awaken the target with a pure bestial hatred toward you. The target's Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma modifiers increase to -2 if they were lower. It becomes hostile to you, attempting to destroy you.

Creatures Creation Rituals

Creature Level Spell Rank Required Cost
-1 or 0 2 15 gp
1 2 60 gp
2 3 105 gp
